title: Part Time HR Consultant
description:
About Zerobeli

Zerobeli is a fast\-growing healthy food manufacturing company specializing in wholegrain, millet\-based and clean\-label bakery products. We are looking for an experienced HR professional to help build structured HR systems as we scale.

Role

We are looking for a practical HR Consultant who can help us establish strong HR processes, policies and systems suitable for a growing manufacturing company.

This is not a routine recruitment role.

We are looking for someone who can build long\-term HR foundations.

Key ResponsibilitiesHR Policies

* Develop Employee Handbook
* Attendance Policy
* Leave Policy
* Probation \& Confirmation Policy
* Performance Review Process
* Increment \& Promotion Guidelines
* Code of Conduct
* Disciplinary Process
* Exit Process

Recruitment System

* Create structured hiring process
* Prepare Job Descriptions
* Develop interview scorecards
* Build candidate database
* Improve hiring process
* Suggest recruitment channels
* Help identify good candidates when required

Employee Systems

* Design onboarding process
* Employee documentation
* Offer letters
* Appointment letters
* Confirmation letters
* Exit documentation

Performance Management

* Develop KPIs for various departments
* Suggest appraisal framework
* Improve accountability
* Help managers implement systems

HR Compliance

* Advise on HR best practices
* Ensure HR documentation is organized
* Recommend improvements where required

Preferred Experience

* 8\+ years HR experience
* Experience with manufacturing/FMCG companies
* Experience creating HR systems from scratch
* Practical approach
* Comfortable working with founders

We are looking for someone who can

✅ Build practical HR systems

✅ Improve organization structure

✅ Help create scalable processes

✅ Guide management on HR best practices

✅ Support recruitment strategy

Engagement

* Part\-time / Consultant
* Flexible working model
* Periodic factory visits required
* Available for guidance as needed

Application Question(s):

* Tell about one company where you built HR systems from scratch. What exactly did you create, and what changed after your work?

Experience:

* HR: 6 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Human Resources Manager - Suryabala Group
description:
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Company:** Suryabala Group of Companies

**Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹30,000 per month

**Experience:** Minimum 3 Years

About Suryabala Group

Suryabala Group is one of Tamil Nadu's leading automobile groups with over three decades of excellence in the automotive industry. We represent multiple leading brands and are expanding our Electric Two\-Wheeler (E2W) business across the region.

Job Responsibilities

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for the E2W division.
* Handle employee onboarding, induction, and documentation.
* Maintain employee records, attendance, and HR compliance.
* Coordinate performance management and employee engagement activities.
* Support payroll inputs, leave management, and statutory compliance.
* Address employee grievances and maintain a positive work environment.
* Work closely with business heads to meet manpower requirements.
* Ensure adherence to company HR policies and processes.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum **3 years of HR experience**, preferably in the automobile or retail industry.
* Strong recruitment and employee relations skills.
* Good knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and HRMS software is preferred.

What We Offer

* Salary: **₹20,000 – ₹30,000/month** (based on experience)
* Career growth with a leading automobile group.
* Opportunity to work in the fast\-growing EV industry.
* Dynamic and supportive work environment

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

* How many years of experience do you have in the HR field?
* Do you have previous experience working in automotive field?
* Are you comfortable working with microsoft suite?

Work Location: In person

title: Placement Coordinator – IT Training Institute
description:
RLT Edzaro is a leading IT Training Institute focused on delivering industry\-oriented programs in AI, Cloud Computing, Full Stack Development, Cybersecurity, Data Science, DevOps, and other emerging technologies. We are looking for an experienced Placement Coordinator to strengthen our corporate network and ensure successful student placements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with IT companies, startups, and recruitment partners.
* Develop new corporate tie\-ups for internships and placement opportunities.
* Coordinate placement drives, walk\-ins, virtual interviews, and campus recruitment activities.
* Connect with HRs, Talent Acquisition teams, and hiring managers to identify hiring requirements.
* Match eligible students with suitable job openings based on their skills and career goals.
* Organize mock interviews, resume\-building sessions, and placement readiness programs.
* Track student placement status and maintain accurate placement records and reports.
* Follow up with recruiters regarding interview feedback and hiring updates.
* Collaborate with trainers and the student counselling team to improve placement outcomes.
* Meet monthly placement targets and continuously expand the recruiter network.

**Requirements**

* 2–5 years of experience as a Placement Coordinator in an IT Training Institute.
* Existing network and strong contacts with multiple IT companies, HR professionals, and recruitment agencies.
* Proven experience in corporate tie\-ups and placement coordination.
* Good understanding of IT job roles including AI, Cloud, Full Stack, DevOps, Data Science, Testing, Cybersecurity, and Software Development.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to organize placement events and manage multiple recruitment activities simultaneously.
* Strong documentation, reporting, and MS Office skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working with EdTech or IT training organizations.
* Knowledge of current IT hiring trends and recruitment processes.
* Experience using LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, and other recruitment platforms.
* Strong networking and corporate relationship\-building abilities.

Work Location: In person

--------------------

===============================================================================================================

  

The Branch Manager – Gold Loans is responsible for driving branch\-level business performance, ensuring compliance, delivering superior customer experience, and maintaining portfolio quality. The role leads the frontline team to achieve disbursement, new customer acquisition, yield, audit, collections, and risk KPIs while upholding operational governance. **2\) Dimensions:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.* **New Relationship**

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure strict adherence to RBI norms, internal policies, risk processes, purity testing, and audit standards. **Portfolio monitoring**

  

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges:** Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section **(****Max 3975 Characters)**
==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\) Key Result Areas:** Writethe key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\- **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports:** Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.
**6\) Relationships:** Describe the nature and purpose of most important contacts or relationship (except superior/team members) with individuals, departments, organizations inside and outside of the organization, that job is required to interact with to deliver the job objectives

Business Associate → HR Trainer → Team Leader → Assistant Branch Head → Business Head.

* Understanding business finances and operations.

* Ability to influence and negotiate.
* Strong business intelligence and corporate knowledge.
* Hardworking and creative nature.
* Excellent communication skills.
* **Immediate Joiners**

* Qualification: Any Graduate/Postgraduate.
* Experience: Freshers are always welcome.
* Experience Range: 0\-2 years.

* Up to Rs. 25,000/\- per month as a Trainee (Package: Best in the Industry/Performance Based Pay Structure).

Selected candidates will be offered rewarding career paths with opportunities for professional and personal growth.

**Best Regards,**  
**MEGHA V**

title: Assistant Front Office Manager
description:
Here is a professional Job Description for an **Assistant Front Office Manager**:

**Job Title:** Assistant Front Office Manager

**Department:** Front Office

**Reports To:** Front Office Manager

Job Summary

The Assistant Front Office Manager assists in managing the daily operations of the Front Office Department to ensure exceptional guest service, efficient check\-in and check\-out procedures, and smooth coordination with all hotel departments. The role supports the Front Office Manager in maintaining operational standards, staff supervision, and achieving guest satisfaction goals.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in overseeing all Front Office operations, including Reception, Concierge, Bell Desk, and Guest Relations.
* Ensure smooth and efficient check\-in and check\-out processes for all guests.
* Handle guest complaints, requests, and special requirements promptly and professionally.
* Supervise, train, and motivate Front Office staff to maintain high service standards.
* Prepare duty rosters and monitor staff attendance, grooming, and performance.
* Ensure all guest records, registrations, and billing procedures are accurate and in compliance with hotel policies.
* Coordinate with Housekeeping, Reservations, Sales, Security, and Maintenance departments to ensure seamless guest experiences.
* Monitor room inventory, occupancy levels, and room allocations in coordination with the Reservations team.
* Assist in preparing departmental reports, including occupancy, guest feedback, and revenue reports.
* Ensure adherence to hotel policies, SOPs, and statutory requirements.
* Conduct regular briefings and departmental meetings with team members.
* Assist in implementing guest engagement initiatives to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.
* Monitor cash handling procedures and ensure proper accounting of transactions.
* Support the Front Office Manager in achieving departmental targets and budget objectives.
* Act as the Front Office Manager in their absence.

Qualifications \& Requirements

* Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Hotel Management or Hospitality Management.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Front Office operations, with at least 1–2 years in a supervisory role.
* Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Property Management Systems (PMS) and Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to handle guest concerns effectively and work under pressure.
* Good knowledge of hotel operations, revenue management, and customer service standards.
* Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and holidays as required.

Key Competencies

* Leadership and Team Management
* Guest Service Excellence
* Problem Solving and Decision Making
* Communication Skills
* Time Management
* Conflict Resolution
* Attention to Detail
* Multitasking Ability
* Organizational Skills
* Professional Grooming and Conduct

Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Guest Satisfaction Scores
* Check\-in/Check\-out Efficiency
* Staff Productivity and Attendance
* Guest Complaint Resolution Time
* Departmental Audit Compliance
* Upselling and Revenue Contribution
* Employee Training and Development
* Front Office Operational Efficiency

This format is suitable for inclusion in your hotel's HR manual, recruitment documents, and performance appraisal system.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Location: India Gujarat Riddhi Siddhi, Kutch


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**1\) Job Purpose:** ***Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2\-3 lines)*** **(Max 1325 Characters)**
===============================================================================================================

  

The Branch Manager – Gold Loans is responsible for driving branch\-level business performance, ensuring compliance, delivering superior customer experience, and maintaining portfolio quality. The role leads the frontline team to achieve disbursement, new customer acquisition, yield, audit, collections, and risk KPIs while upholding operational governance.

 **2\) Dimensions:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.*

 **New Relationship**  

(Max 254 Characters)

  

Build strong relationships with local customers, partners, authorities, and community influencers to drive branch customer acquisition.

 **Managing Existing Relationship**  

(Max 254 Characters)

  

Lead and supervise branch staff including ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE; ensure productivity and performance management

 **Structuring new Transactions**  

(Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure accurate gold valuation, loan structuring within LTV norms, and proper documentation for all new and renewal transactions

 **Compliance of regulatory guidelines**  

(Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure strict adherence to RBI norms, internal policies, risk processes, purity testing, and audit standards.

 **Portfolio monitoring**

  

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric

**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges: Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section (Max 3975 Characters)**
======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**


Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.

  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.

  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII.

 **Business Context**


Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management.

 **Job Context:**

  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls

  

Key Challenges:

* Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\) Key Result Areas: Write the key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\-** **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)**

  

Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

 **Business Growth \& Acquisition**

* Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management**

* Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management**

* Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management**

* Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance**

* Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience**

* Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity**

* Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports: Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)**
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.
**6\) Relationships: Describe the nature and purpose of most important contacts or relationship (except superior/team members) with individuals, departments, organizations inside and outside of the organization, that job is required to interact with to deliver the job objectives**
=========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

**Relationship Type (Max 80 Characters)**
=========================================

**Frequency**
=============

**Nature (Max 1325 Characters)**
================================

Regional / Cluster Heads

  

Daily

System issues, process enhancements, user support.

Local campaigns, lead generation, customer engagement programs.

 **External**

Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls

* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.

**Location:** Ambernath, Mumbai

**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday

**Working Hours:** 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM

**Salary:** ₹4,000 per month

**Job Overview:**

We are looking for a passionate and analytical Engineering Fresher to join our team as a Software Developer / Data Analyst. The role combines software development, data analytics, and financial research. The selected candidate will work on technology\-driven solutions while analyzing financial and operational data of listed Indian companies.

This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy problem\-solving, programming, automation, data analysis, and working with real\-world business and financial data.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Analyze annual reports, quarterly results, investor presentations, stock exchange filings, and other public disclosures of listed Indian companies.
* Data Analysis \& Research
* Collect, validate, clean, and organize large datasets from multiple sources.
* Prepare financial summaries, business reports, and analytical insights.
* Conduct industry, peer, and competitor analysis.

**Software Development:**

* Develop and maintain internal software applications and automation tools using python, postgresql, flutter and ubuntu server.
* Assist in database design, management, and optimization.
* Support web\-based applications and internal dashboards.
* Automate repetitive business processes to improve operational efficiency.
* Participate in testing, debugging, and deployment of software solutions.

**Reporting \& Documentation:**

* Prepare reports using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Build dashboards, charts, and data visualizations.
* Maintain project documentation and technical records.
* Present findings to the management team whenever required.

**Eligibility Criteria:**

* M.E./M.Tech/B.E./B.Tech (Completed) in Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, or any related Engineering discipline.
* M.Sc/MCA candidates can also apply.
* Freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with internship or academic project experience in software development or data analytics will have an added advantage.

**Required Skills:**

**Technical Skills:**

* Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Word.
* Basic programming knowledge in Python, SQL, Java, C\+\+, Flutter, or similar technologies.
* Understanding of databases and data structures.
* Familiarity with APIs and automation concepts is desirable.

**Analytical Skills:**

* Strong analytical and logical reasoning.
* Excellent problem\-solving ability.
* High attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Ability to interpret financial and business information.

**Soft Skills:**

* Good written and verbal communication.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and financial concepts.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team.

Overview:

We’re looking for a proactive **HR Generalist** to support our fast\-growing Hyderabad team. This role focuses on end\-to\-end payroll processing in India, employee relations (ER) case handling, and day\-to\-day HR support. You’ll ensure statutory compliance, provide high\-quality employee service, and partner with managers to foster a positive, inclusive workplace.
Who you are::
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree (Human Resources, Business, Commerce, or related field). MBA/PGDM in HR is a plus.
* **Experience:** **2–5 years** in HR operations with **hands\-on India payroll processing** and **employee relations** exposure.
* **Tools:** Experience with **HRIS** (e.g., Workday, SuccessFactors, BambooHR) and **payroll systems** (e.g., Keka, greytHR, Zoho Payroll). Strong **Excel** skills (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, reconciliation).
* **Knowledge:** Working knowledge of India labor laws and statutory frameworks—**EPF/ESI**, **Income Tax/TDS**, **Professional Tax**, **Payment of Bonus Act**, **Gratuity Act**, **POSH**, and **Shops \& Establishments**.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication; ability to handle sensitive matters with discretion.
* **Mindset:** Detail\-oriented, adaptable, demonstrates learning agility, open to feedback, service\-focused, organised, and comfortable in a fast\-paced, growth environment.


What you'll be doing::
**Payroll (India)*** Own monthly payroll processing for Hyderabad employees in partnership with Finance and payroll vendors/tools.
* Maintain accurate employee data (new hires, exits, increments, variable pay, attendance, leaves) in HRIS/payroll systems.
* Calculate and validate statutory components: **PF/EPF**, **ESI**, **Professional Tax**, **TDS**, **Gratuity**, **Bonus**, **Leave encashment**; ensure accurate **Form 16** distribution and investment declaration handling.
* Prepare and file statutory returns/reports; coordinate audits and respond to queries.
* Reconcile payroll and resolve discrepancies; manage off\-cycle payments when needed.
* Track statutory and policy changes; update payroll practices accordingly.

 **Employee Relations (ER) \& HR Advisory*** Serve as a first point\-of\-contact for employee concerns, policy queries, and conflict resolution; triage and document ER cases.
* Act as the primary contact for all insurance benefit matters, including additions, deletions, corrections, e\-card issuance, renewals, TPA coordination, and providing support or resolving employee queries.
* Support investigations (fact\-finding, documentation, interview notes) in partnership with HR Director/Legal.
* Coach managers on performance management basics (PIPs, feedback, documentation) and fair application of policies.
* Promote an inclusive, respectful workplace; support **POSH** compliance (awareness sessions, case routing to ICC).
* Facilitate grievance handling, exit interviews, and trend analysis to recommend action plans.

**HR Operations \& Compliance*** Coordinate onboarding, orientation, and probation confirmations; maintain personnel files and HRIS data integrity.
* Administer benefits (medical insurance, wellness programs) and coordinate vendor issues.
* Track **Shops \& Establishments** compliance for the Hyderabad office; maintain HR SOPs and local policies.
* Support engagement initiatives, pulse surveys, town halls, and recognition programs.
* Prepare HR dashboards (headcount, attrition, ER cases, leave utilization) with actionable insights.
* Ensure data privacy and confidentiality across all HR processes.
* Prepare any adhoc report/ data needed by leaders

description:
* **Vacancies:** 1 No
* **Industry:** Architectural / High\-End Lighting Solutions
* **Job Locations:** Mumbai / Bangalore / Chandigarh
* **Qualification:** Engineering graduate (Electrical / Electronics / Architecture preferred)
* **Desired Experience:** 5–7 years


  
**About the Role:** We are looking for a young, dynamic, and talented Lighting Designer with strong experience in designing lighting solutions for high\-end residential and commercial projects. The candidate must be skilled in using leading lighting design software and comfortable working directly with architects, sales teams, and visiting project sites.


Key Role \& Responsibilities


* **Lighting Design \& Technical Work**
* + Create detailed lighting designs, layouts, and concepts for premium residential and commercial projects.
	+ Prepare lighting calculations, simulations, and renderings using Dialux, AGI\-32, and related tools.
	+ Develop high\-quality visual presentations and concept boards using Photoshop.
	+ Prepare and modify detailed drawings using AutoCAD.
	+ Ensure designs meet aesthetics, functionality, compliance, and energy\-efficiency standards.
* **Collaboration \& Coordination**
* + Work closely with the sales team to understand client requirements and offer appropriate lighting solutions.
	+ Participate in client meetings along with sales to explain design concepts and product selections.
	+ Coordinate with architects, interior designers, consultants, and project managers.
* **Site Visits \& Project Execution**
* + Conduct site visits to assess space conditions, architectural details, and design intent.
	+ Provide on\-site design inputs and ensure proper implementation of the lighting plan.
	+ Support project teams during installation and final focusing/commissioning when required.
* **Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* + Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical / Electronics / Architectural Engineering).
	+ 5–7 years of experience in lighting design for premium residential and commercial segments.
	+ Proficiency in Dialux, AGI\-32, Photoshop, and AutoCAD — mandatory.
	+ Strong understanding of lighting principles, product types, optics, controls, and application techniques.
	+ Excellent communication and presentation skills.
	+ Creative, detail\-oriented, and able to translate design intent into practical lighting solutions.
	+ Willingness to travel for site visits, architect meetings, and project reviews.

title: VP, India Onboarding and KYC operations
description:
Date live: 07/17/2026


Business Area: Barclays Payments Merchant Services


Area of Expertise: Banking Operations


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000119801


  
At Barclays, we don’t just adapt to the future – we create it. Embark on a transformative journey as a **VP,** **India Onboarding and KYC operations** is accountable for leading Remediation and Quality functions for BPL based in India with additional local oversight of Onboarding. You will own and drive the ongoing performance of the onboarding, quality and remediation functions, ensuring merchants are onboarded efficiently, compliantly, and with a consistently high\-quality experience that accelerates time\-to\-revenue. You will oversee significant KYC remediation activity ensuring activity is performed efficiently compliantly, with excellent quality and cost performance. Additionally the role holder will have direct responsibility for the global Quality Control team overseeing all checking across Onboarding and Refresh activity. Support the considerable change and transformation agenda for BPL, operationally landing the significant technology and process change driven by the Return To Satisfactory program.
**Key Responsibilities**


Quality focus


* Oversight of all Quality performance globally across UK and India, leading on SLA/KRI performance for QA (Quality assurance) scores.
* Quality improvement plans to drive root cause analysis and data drive improvement to quality performance across all teams and locations.

Operational Performance


* Oversight of operational performance of onboarding with operational delivery performance across all merchant segments, ensuring consistent execution against agreed SLAs and KRIs.
* Drive improvements in onboarding, remediation cycle times, quality, predictability and efficiency.
* Ensure onboarding and remediation processes are robust, scalable, and compliant with regulatory and control requirements.
* Champion automation and tooling to reduce manual effort and improve merchant and colleague experience.

Remediation


* Oversight of the execution for all KYC remediation activity creating appropriate MI and managing burndown plans to time, cost and correct quality.

People focused leadership


* A key senior leader within the BPL KYC operation within India and partnering with UK to drive forwards the colleague agenda – providing focused leadership on talent attraction, retention, development and employee engagement activity.

**Key Deliverables:**


* Operationally readiness and successful landing of all planned technology/procedural change linked to Payments Return To Satisfactory program.
* Oversight and accountability for successful execution of all remediation activity and populations.
* Delivery of green SLA/KRI for all activity processed by India Onboarding and KYC Operations – with global accountability for Quality performance across all functions.
* Define and execute optimization roadmap, and efficiency targets for India Onboarding and KYC Operations.

**To be successful as a VP,** **India Onboarding and KYC operations, you should have experience with:**


* Significant KYC Operational leadership experience with specific experience in Payments acquiring a must.
* Proven experience of large scale people management across multiple sites.
* Strong understanding of KYC and Financial crime requirements for UK and European markets.
* Strong understanding of customer journeys and client sectors across SME and Corp.
* Demonstrable experience of process optimization through process improvement / technology enhancements.
* Significant experience in operational management disciplines driving performance enhancements across quality, cost, delivery and customer experience.
* Able to translate complex financial crime issues into clear operational risk, service impact and executive\-ready recommendations.
* In applying for the Pune based role, applicants have to reside in Pune already, this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or relocation support. Applicants must already hold the legal right to work in the UK.
* This role is intended for candidates who are already operating at Director level.

**Some of Highly Valued Skills may include:**


* Problem Solving and analytical skills to provide though leadership at any problem.
* Experience in banking or financial services domain.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


The location for this role is Pune \& Gurugram, IN.


**Purpose of the role**


To manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives and compliance with relevant regulators.


**Accountabilities**


* Identification of trends and opportunities to improve areas and develop new process and procedures through the monitoring and analysis of operation data and performance metrices.
* Management of operations for a business area and promote efficient processes, risk management and compliance initiatives to support the bank's operations.
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders (including business leaders, project manager and SMEs) and external stakeholders (including vendors and service providers) to support business operations and promote alignment with the bank's objectives and SLAs.
* Management of operational professionals and provide guidance, coaching and support to improve colleagues' delivery quality.
* Management and development of KPIs to measure the effectiveness of operation functions, utilising data and technology to support the identification of areas that require improvement.
* Compliance with all regulatory requirements and internal policies related to customer experience.
* Creation of a safe environment for colleagues to speak up, actively and regularly encourage and solicit feedback to ensure people agenda remains focused on the right areas.
* Management of attrition by working closely with HR in implementing retention initiatives for work force.

**Vice President Expectations**


* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

The WFA Data Specialist works closely with the HR Capability Center team to ensure the integrity of the data entered into the Workday Human Capital Management System (HCM). This position will process new hire transactions, review job change transactions generated from the ATS, and process time off and absence transactions, employee/manager direct access submissions to ensure that all data is accurately actioned on a timely basis. Additionally, this role will be responsible for basic foundational data maintenance including Supervisory organizations, Cost Center assignments, and Position Titles. The Capability Center team will rely on the WFA Data Specialist to complete reports, documents, and forms that require specific data from the HCM system, including People Doc processes.
  

  

This role is also responsible for payroll reconciliation activities, which involves reviewing audit reports, analyzing discrepancies, and processing appropriate updates to ensure the feed from Workday to payroll is correct.


**Detailed Position Responsibilities:**

* Maintain and/or approve all data pertaining to employee records (i.e., transfers, personal information, title changes, etc.) that are entered in Workday through Manager or Employee Direct Access.
* Complete pending new hire transactions in Workday HCM after the candidate is in Ready to Hire status in the ATS
* Support execution of employee movement, employee status, time off and leave absence, payroll, benefits/leaves, Performance Check\-ins, and compensation processes, by maintaining the accurate and on time data in Workday, relevant for the above processes
* Support the integrity of employee records and Workday data, assuring legal and regulatory compliance.
* Maintain supervisory organizations, organization assignments, and position titles in the Workday system
* Complete weekly payroll reconciliation reviewing audit reports, analyzing discrepancies, and processing appropriate updates.
* Support new hire benefits enrollment including ensure all required documents are collected; Accurately enter benefit enrollment data into systems; Ensure that all benefit enrollment processes adhere to company policies, following the process: Address any issues or discrepancies related to benefit enrollment promptly and effectively.
* Support the global recognition program



	+ Transaction Award Process where manual intervention is required, e.g. Calcel Award, moving awards to the next approval (to avoid delay in the award)
	+ Bulk Upload process. This includes the review and approval process
	+ Provide Bravo Report to business
* Support leave of absence transactions



	+ Process requests for time and absence, Holidays, vacation request including individual or mass changes.
	+ Escalation to Senior/Manager for when necessary to support resolution of inquiries.
* Process Employee Reimbursement Transactions including



	+ Validate documentation submitted by employee and request reimbursement for employees via payroll. Payments include: Meal Vouchers; Spending accounts; Passes; etc.
	+ Review and confirm the invoices’ details against the services received from the vendors who are managed by People Services, in collaboration with the PS Global Vendor Management team
* Participate in the review of integration kickout reports from various systems and process updates in Workday based on the identified discrepancies
* Participate on ad\-hoc projects and perform other duties as assigned.
* Directly participate to enhance and improve the content/FAQ/LWI based on the feedback received via case resolution, by collaborating with functional teams to achieve this
* Identify and troubleshoot issues and escalate as appropriate
* Make process recommendations to achieve operational excellence
* Participate in scheduled and ad hoc training or other forms of learning opportunities in order to improve process acumen, and apply the learnings in executing their role, and to develop their own skills as per needed
* Work collaboratively within the HR team to share ideas, ownership, and accountability for driving improvements and consistency of execution for key HR processes, across regions and functional areas
* Identify and report cases trends or product trends to the management team and Senior WFA and work collaboratively with them or other HR functional teams to improve the HR service we provide to our workforce.
* Collaborate with all functional teams in order for People Service to collectively achieve TAT and FLR

  

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree / equivalent qualification in HR or min of 1 year of working with HRIS/HCM systems
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, strong interpersonal skills
* Ability to work successfully in a fast paced and continuously changing work environment
* Detail oriented with a focus on accuracy and quality
* Advanced proficiency with MS Excel and a proven ability to manipulate data and an ability to learn required business systems
* Ability to learn quickly and apply knowledge effectively
* Collaborates effectively in a team environment

**Ideal Candidates Would Also Have:**

* Knowledge of Workday
* Experience working within an HR Shared Services delivery model
* Have worked in a multi\-cultural/multi\-country work environment

*If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.*

With a single vision as inspiring as “Transforming patients’ lives through science™ ”, every BMS employee plays an integral role in work that goes far beyond ordinary. Each of us is empowered to apply our individual talents and unique perspectives in a supportive culture, promoting global participation in clinical trials, while our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues.

description:
Role Description:
**Company Introduction :**  

  

Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and related services, provided to customers and partners in over 220 countries and territories through six primary consumer\-facing brands \- Booking.com, KAYAK, priceline, agoda.com, and OpenTable. The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. **Job Overview :**  

  

Booking Holdings India is a Center of Excellence (COE) based in Bangalore, India and was created to support the increasing business demands of Booking Holdings Inc. and its Brands. The COE is a key enabler of Booking Holdings Inc.’s global talent strategy for several technology functions such as Cybersecurity, Fraud monitoring/analytics, IT, and others across our Brand subsidiaries.  

The COE is looking for a seasoned employee relations professional with deep expertise in labour laws and Labour Compliance to support the COE Senior Legal Counsel (Legal \& Compliance) in overseeing the COE’s adherence to local laws and regulations, handling employee relations matters in partnership with the People team, implementing Compliance \& Ethics program initiatives at the COE, and to provide the People Team support as needed in Policy drafting and reviews. **Job Responsibilities :**  

  

Together with the Senior Legal Counsel, Legal \& Compliance and India People Lead, lead the employee relations activities:  

  

* Employee Relations:


(i) Act as the primary point of contact to receive all the Employee Relation Matters reported within India COE,  

(ii) Handle employee grievance and take end to end ownership of conducting a due diligence on the matters received, reporting and summarizing the issues and recommending corrective actions on the matters and tracking them to closure,
(iii) Maintaining a comprehensive dashboard to ensure we have visibility of all such issues reported, (iv) share a quarterly dashboard and also lead org wide initiatives to drive corrective actions.  

  

* Labour Law Compliance


(i) Lead all the statutory (non \- payroll related) compliances
(ii) Monitor and supervise the compliance filings managed by external consultants and ensure that the company is compliant with its regulatory filings (e.g Shops and Establishment Act, CLRA, Minimum Wages, EPF, Gratuity.)  

(iii) Monitor regulatory changes and ensure timely implementation s (e.g Menstrual Leave and New Labor Code) and program manage them to closure.  

(iii)Together with the Senior Legal Counsel, Legal \& Compliance and India People Lead, lead and own the policies mandated by the Shops and Establishment Act, the Contract Labor Regulations Act and/ or driven by the work environment and drive compliance of the policy  

(For e.g. Contingent Worker policy, Working in Shifts or On \- Call, Hybrid Work arrangements policy, Creche/ Day care etc.)  

(iv) Support internal and external compliance audits
* Governance \& Risk Management


(i) Track and report on the Compliance KPI with BH Compliance teams and regularly drive compliance on the timely completion of compliance training. Track and report the issues with Compliance Trainings.  

(ii) Drive rigor around topics such as Ethics Ambassador, Prevention of Sexual Harassment committee and Global Ethics Day etc. Track, analyse and report data on PIPs, successful and unsuccessful, and Probation non confirmation cases. Maintain a repository of all the  

relevant documents in one folder and ensure that we are following the right procedures and controls on this.  

(iii) Conduct onboarding/ awareness sessions for new hires on Legal and Compliance obligations for new hires.  

(iv) Drive regular updates on policies and reviews with the People, Legal and Finance team to ensure that policies are updated and compliant with the latest regulations etc.  

  

**Qualifications :*** 8–10 years of work experience ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations (including the Prevention of Sexual Harassment Act (“POSH”) and employment/labor), advising on employee relations matters and assisting with fact finding through witness interviews and memoranda drafting, and implementing compliance and ethics programs
* A bachelor’s degree in human resources, or a related field.
* A master’s degree (e.g., MBA in HR, Master’s in HR/IR) or especially valuable for handling complex employee issues, investigations, and labour compliance.
* Fluency in English and ability to work and communicate directly in English.
* Ability to articulate complex matters to the COE management team.
* Strong writing and editing skills and solid organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* This is an independent contributor role that involves close collaboration with both India\-based and international stakeholders, as well as functional teams. Therefore, the ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse functions, backgrounds, and locations to influence perspectives and build consensus is essential.
* Ability to comfortably work with both audiences within and outside the Legal department and across all levels in the organization.
* Ability to engage with employees and hold fact\-finding conversations in the context of employee relations matters independently.

  

Other Skills  

* International experience: Self\-awareness of communication style and cultural differences.
* Experience with employee matters and responsibilities.
* Consultative style: Ability to formulate and articulate a perspective and present it in a manner that generates understanding and alignment.
* Self\-motivated and capable of operating independently with limited oversight. Strong sense of personal accountability for work tasks.
* Comfortable acting in a role both as individual contributor and influencer.
* Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and a fast\-paced entrepreneurial environment.
* Assertive, intellectually curious, and self\-starter personality

title: Head of India Tax
description:

Job Description:
This is a role within the Castrol organisation and the successful candidate will become part of the Castrol ring\-fence. If you are part of the ring\-fence, it is expected that your employment will move with Castrol to new ownership.
Are you ready to join a team that’s driving the future of lubricants \& beyond and setting new industry standards? Discover how our diverse and hard\-working people at Castrol are shaping the industry – and how you can be part of this journey.
We’re seeking versatile guides who share our passion for innovation and excellence. Bring your outstanding perspective, collaborative spirit, and challenge our thinking as we continue to lead the way in the lubricants' market \& build businesses beyond lubricants. This is your chance to learn, grow, and thrive in a dynamic and inclusive organization.
Apply now!
Castrol is a global leader in lubricants and part of the bp Group, one of the world’s largest energy companies. In India, Castrol is a publicly listed company, leading in the Automotive, Industrial, and Marine lubricant sectors. With iconic brands, relentless innovation, strong customer relationships, and a team of highly motivated employees, we have maintained our market leadership in India for over a century. Our robust manufacturing and distribution network in India helps us reach consumers through more than 135,000 outlets.
At Castrol, success knows no bounds. We offer a fast\-paced learning environment where you can develop your career, whether in specialized functions or on a general management track. Castrol India has a proud legacy of championing top talent for leadership roles, both locally and globally!
Role Overview:
The Head of India Tax is responsible for leading and overseeing all tax matters relating to Castrol's operations in India and Pakistan. The role acts as a senior tax leader, the principal holder of relationships with fiscal authorities and senior business leaders, and is accountable for ensuring effective tax governance, compliance and risk management across the organisation.
The Head of India Tax will have primary accountability for managing all tax audits, enquiries, investigations and disputes, whilst ensuring that tax compliance, governance, risk management and advisory support are delivered effectively through a combination of internal teams, outsourced providers, external advisers and joint venture support arrangements.
The role provides leadership and oversight across all taxes affecting the business, including Corporate Income Tax, Indirect Taxes, Employment Taxes and Transfer Pricing. Support is provided through a combination of internal resources, a service agreement with a joint venture partner (bp) and its third\-party service providers, support from Castrol CC and external advisers. The role holder retains overall accountability for the quality, integrity and effectiveness of all tax activities delivered through these arrangements.
The Head of India Tax will be a member of the Castrol Head of Tax Leadership Team and will actively contribute to the development and delivery of Castrol's tax strategy, governance framework, risk management approach and leadership agenda.
Role and Responsibility
Reporting to the Castrol Head of Tax, the Head of India Tax will be a key contributor to the delivery of Castrol's tax strategy and objectives, providing tax expertise across all aspects of the business and actively contributing to the Castrol Tax Leadership Team.
Business Partnering and Advisory
Provide tax advice and support to Castrol's commercial operations in India and Pakistan across all taxes.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with business leadership teams to understand commercial strategies and business objectives and provide tax support that enables informed decision\-making.
Provide practical and commercially focused tax advice on business initiatives, restructurings, supply chain changes, new business opportunities and strategic projects.
Work with internal customers and external advisers to identify solutions that appropriately balance business objectives, compliance requirements and tax risk management.
Monitor developments in tax legislation and policy and provide guidance on the impact of those developments on the business.
Support engagement with industry groups, government bodies and fiscal authorities on matters affecting the business.
Tax Risk Management, Governance and Compliance
Work with the Castrol Tax Leadership Team to identify, assess and manage tax risks in accordance with Castrol's governance framework and ethical principles.
Maintain oversight of all direct and indirect tax compliance activities performed by internal teams, external providers and joint venture partners.
Ensure the timely and accurate completion of tax filings, Corporate Income Tax compliance, transfer pricing documentation and all associated compliance obligations.
Oversee tax payment obligations, tax reporting requirements and compliance calendars across the jurisdictions within scope.
Manage the design, documentation and monitoring of tax compliance processes and controls, working closely with Finance teams and external service providers.
Oversee tax governance processes and ensure appropriate controls are in place to support compliance with local regulatory requirements.
Support forecasting and monitoring of cash taxes and, where required, provide oversight of tax accounting and reporting activities.
Ensure compliance with all applicable tax laws, regulations and filing obligations across the jurisdictions within scope.
Continuously review tax compliance arrangements to ensure they remain effective, efficient and aligned with business requirements.
Tax Authorities, Audits and Controversy Management
Act as the primary relationship holder with fiscal authorities across the jurisdictions within scope.
Develop and maintain constructive and professional relationships with tax authorities and relevant government bodies.
Lead the management of all tax audits, enquiries, investigations and disputes.
Coordinate responses to tax authority requests and ensure appropriate governance and documentation is maintained.
Work with tax authorities, government bodies and external advisers to resolve tax disputes and achieve appropriate technical and commercial outcomes.
Provide leadership and oversight in relation to significant tax risks, uncertain tax positions and tax controversy matters.
Tax Operations and Compliance Oversight
Oversee all tax activities delivered through outsourced providers, external advisers, joint venture support arrangements and Transitional Service Agreements.
Ensure roles, responsibilities and accountabilities are clearly defined between all parties involved in delivering tax activities.
Monitor service delivery arrangements to ensure compliance obligations are fulfilled accurately and on a timely basis.
Support the transition of tax activities from TSA\-supported arrangements to a sustainable long\-term compliance model.
Establish and maintain appropriate compliance monitoring and reporting processes.
Ensure robust documentation is maintained to support tax filings, tax positions, audit activity and governance requirements.
Work closely with Finance teams to ensure the quality and integrity of data used in support of tax compliance and reporting activities.
Promote consistency in tax governance, controls and compliance standards across all jurisdictions within scope.
Leadership and Culture
As a senior leader within Castrol, the Head of India Tax will be expected to inspire and empower others to achieve organisational objectives while actively supporting the culture, values and strategic ambitions of the organisation.
Directly manage, mentor and develop a high\-performing team of tax professionals, promoting a culture of excellence, inclusion and professional growth.
Provide leadership and oversight to tax resources located within India and support the management of tax activities relating to Pakistan.
Essential Experience and Qualifications
Educated to degree level with a relevant professional tax, accounting or legal qualification.
Extensive tax planning, advisory, compliance and risk management experience within a global or multinational environment.
Strong knowledge of Indian tax legislation and practice, including Corporate Income Tax, GST, Employment Taxes and Transfer Pricing.
Awareness of tax requirements affecting Pakistan and the ability to oversee compliance obligations through internal resources, external advisers and service providers.
Significant experience managing tax authorities, audits, enquiries, disputes and regulatory interactions.
Demonstrated experience of providing practical, commercially focused tax advice to senior business partners.
Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organisation.
Experience managing external advisers, outsourced service providers and multi\-party delivery models.
Significant experience managing complex tax compliance and governance activities within a multinational environment.
Strong understanding of tax governance, internal controls and compliance frameworks.
Experience establishing and operating tax compliance processes and control frameworks across multiple jurisdictions.
Experience managing tax accounting, cash tax and tax reporting requirements.
Adaptability and resilience, with a willingness to lead and support change where appropriate.
Proven ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams and build productive relationships across Finance, Legal, HR, Commercial and Operational functions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex tax concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
Desirable Experience and Qualifications
Experience within the consumer products, manufacturing or other complex multinational sectors.
Experience supporting business separations, joint ventures, mergers, acquisitions or large\-scale organisational change programmes.
Experience handling Transitional Service Agreements and transitioning tax activities into standalone operating models.
Experience managing tax activities across more than one jurisdiction, including through outsourced providers and external advisers.
Familiarity with OECD tax developments and international taxation matters affecting multinational groups.
You will work with :
Outside of the wider Castrol Tax function, the Head of India Tax will develop and maintain strong working relationships with a broad range of internal and external customers to support compliance, governance, risk management and business decision\-making across India and Pakistan.
Key External Stakeholders
Fiscal authorities and government bodies.
External tax advisers and compliance service providers.
Joint venture partner tax and finance teams.
Government and regulatory authorities across jurisdictions within scope.
Key Internal Stakeholders
Castrol Head of Tax.
Castrol Tax Leadership Team.
India Country Leadership Team.
Regional and global leadership teams relevant to India and Pakistan operations.
Business leaders across India and Pakistan operations.
Finance leadership and key Finance interfaces, particularly where tax data, reporting inputs and financial information are required.
Local Finance and Accounting teams.
Legal, Treasury, Human Resources, Company Secretariat, Risk and Compliance functions.
Internal Audit and Controls teams.
Shared service and business support teams involved in tax compliance and reporting activities.
Why join our team?
We support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and exciting environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to crafting an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
Travel Requirement
Some travel may be required with this role, this is negotiable
Relocation Assistance:
This role is eligible for relocation within country
Remote Type:
This position is not available for remote working

acquisitions and disposals activity, Analytical Thinking, Commercial Acumen, Creativity and Innovation, Data Management, Digital Fluency, Direct and indirect tax compliance and accounting, Economic modelling, Financial Reporting, Influencing tax law and policy, Interpreting and applying tax law, Management of change, Managing tax dispute resolution and controversies, Project Management, Risk Management, Stakeholder Engagement, Tax advice for mergers, Tax advisory, Tax compliance process management, Tax reporting and control, Transfer Pricing
Legal Disclaimer:

We do not discriminate on the basis of protected characteristics like race, religion, color, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, veteran status or disability status.
