**About the Role**  

We are seeking a dynamic and seasoned professional to lead our Ecommerce Delivery Practice, driving excellence in ecommerce solutioning, implementation, operations, and delivery governance across all client engagements. This role calls for a strategic thinker with strong technical depth, delivery leadership, stakeholder management, and a proven track record of scaling ecommerce practices in a fast paced digital or media ecosystem.  

The Head of Ecommerce Delivery Practice will own the practice vision, capability roadmap, delivery health, quality benchmarks, and P\&L oversight, ensuring our clients receive market\-leading ecommerce execution and measurable business impact.  

  

**1\. Practice Leadership \& Strategy**

* Define and own the ecommerce delivery practice roadmap, operating model, and capability development strategy.
* Build and scale cross\-functional competencies including ecommerce operations, performance commerce, tech implementation, commerce media, and omnichannel enablement.
* Evaluate emerging trends, platforms (Shopify, Magento, Salesforce Commerce, WooCommerce), and martech/advertising technologies to continuously strengthen practice offerings.

**2\. Delivery Governance \& Excellence**

* Oversee end\-to\-end delivery of ecommerce programs across clients, ensuring on\-time, on\-budget, and high\-quality execution.
* Establish and enforce delivery frameworks, QA processes, sprint governance, risk management practices, and SLAs.
* Provide escalation leadership and ensure swift resolution of delivery bottlenecks.

**3\. Client Engagement \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the senior delivery owner for key enterprise ecommerce clients.
* Partner with Business Leads, Client Partners, Media teams, Creative, Performance Marketing, and Technology stakeholders to deliver integrated commerce solutions.
* Drive strategic conversations on ecommerce transformation, platform enhancement, conversion optimisation, and omnichannel customer journeys.

**4\. People Management \& Capability Building**

* Manage and mentor a multidisciplinary delivery team of 60 – 80 members.
* Attract, groom, and retain high\-performing talent; shape a strong culture of delivery discipline and innovation.
* Partner with HR to define hiring plans, competency matrices, and L\&D tracks for the practice.

**5\. Operational \& Financial Ownership**

* Own practice\-level capacity planning, project allocation, utilisation management and revenue forecasting.
* Enhance commercial models, drive margin improvements, and ensure financial health across ecommerce engagements.
* Drive operational excellence through automation, process optimisation, and best‑practice adoption.

**6\. Innovation \& Growth**

* Collaborate with sales/business development teams to shape winning proposals, pitches, and ecommerce solutions.
* Identify and build strategic partnerships with platforms, technology providers, and commerce enablers.

title: Business Operations and Compliance Specialist
description:
**Business Operations and Compliance Specialist**

**Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent  
**Location:** India  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote initially, transitioning to hybrid or in\-office in 2027  
**Department:** Business Operations  
**Reports To:** Chief Operating Officer

**About the Role**

We are a growing managed services provider and technology reseller delivering managed IT services, technical support, cloud solutions, cybersecurity services, software licensing, technology projects, and compliance support.

We are hiring a Business Operations and Compliance Specialist to support the Chief Operating Officer in managing internal operations, maintaining business processes, coordinating compliance activities, and improving accountability across departments.

This is a permanent business operations role. It is not a temporary project management position.

The successful candidate will work across Finance, HR, Sales, Service Delivery, Technical Support, and leadership to ensure operational tasks are documented, assigned, completed, and reported accurately.

Key ResponsibilitiesBusiness Operations

* Support the COO in managing company\-wide operational processes
* Maintain operational workflows, checklists, procedures, and internal controls
* Coordinate activities between Finance, HR, Sales, Service Delivery, and Technical teams
* Track deadlines, assigned owners, dependencies, risks, and overdue items
* Follow up with department leaders and employees on incomplete operational tasks
* Identify process gaps, duplicated responsibilities, and workflow issues
* Recommend practical process improvements
* Maintain records of operational decisions, approvals, and action items
* Support recurring operations meetings and document follow\-up actions
* Escalate major delays, risks, or compliance concerns to the COO

**Client Onboarding and Offboarding**

* Maintain the client onboarding and offboarding workflow
* Coordinate tasks across Sales, Finance, Service Delivery, and Technical teams
* Track completion of contracts, billing setup, technical requirements, documentation, and approvals
* Support structured handoffs between Sales, Projects, and Managed Services
* Monitor onboarding timelines and report delays
* Confirm required client documentation is complete and stored correctly

Technical teams will remain responsible for technical implementation and support activities.

**Employee Onboarding and Offboarding**

* Coordinate employee onboarding and offboarding checklists
* Track responsibilities assigned to HR, IT, Finance, and department managers
* Confirm that equipment, system access, documentation, training, and approvals are completed
* Follow up on missing or delayed tasks
* Maintain accurate onboarding and offboarding records

HR will continue to own recruiting, employment agreements, employee relations, payroll coordination, personnel records, and employment compliance.

**Policies, SOPs, and Documentation**

* Maintain the company’s policy, procedure, SOP, and how\-to guide register
* Track document owners, approval status, review dates, and completion deadlines
* Work with department leaders to identify missing or outdated documentation
* Maintain approved templates, formatting standards, and version control
* Confirm approved documents are stored in the correct location
* Coordinate scheduled policy and procedure reviews
* Report overdue or incomplete documentation to the COO

Department leaders will remain responsible for writing and approving the content related to their functions.

**SOC 2 and Compliance Support**

* Support the company’s SOC 2 readiness and ongoing compliance activities
* Maintain control trackers, evidence registers, compliance calendars, and remediation lists
* Coordinate evidence collection across Finance, HR, IT, Security, Sales, and Operations
* Follow up with control owners on outstanding tasks and evidence
* Organize policies, reports, screenshots, approvals, and supporting records
* Support meetings with external compliance consultants and auditors
* Track compliance gaps and remediation activities
* Escalate overdue controls or significant risks to the COO
* Help integrate compliance requirements into daily business operations
* Support other compliance frameworks as the company grows

This role does not serve as the company’s auditor or technical security engineer.

**Operational Reporting**

* Prepare weekly and monthly operations reports
* Maintain dashboards for operational tasks, compliance progress, onboarding, documentation, and internal initiatives
* Report risks, blockers, overdue actions, and recurring issues
* Maintain accurate records of assigned owners and completion dates
* Support the COO with data required for leadership reviews
* Help develop measurable operational KPIs

**Vendor and Asset Records**

* Maintain vendor operational records, agreements, reviews, and assigned owners
* Support vendor onboarding documentation and review activities
* Coordinate asset tracking with Finance and Technical teams
* Maintain records of company equipment and assigned assets
* Support periodic asset and vendor reviews

Finance will continue to own purchasing, purchase orders, budgets, payments, and financial approvals.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in business operations, compliance operations, technology operations, PMO support, internal controls, or a related position
* Experience working in a technology company, IT services provider, managed services provider, SaaS company, cybersecurity company, or consulting environment
* Experience coordinating activities across multiple departments
* Understanding of business processes, operational controls, and process documentation
* Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, audit readiness, information security compliance, or similar frameworks
* Strong documentation, reporting, and organizational skills
* Ability to professionally follow up with task owners and escalate delays
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Excel, Word, Teams, Outlook, and SharePoint
* Willingness to transition to a hybrid or office\-based arrangement in 2027

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working for an MSP or technology reseller
* Experience supporting a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 implementation
* Experience with Zoho One, Zoho Projects, Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with managed IT services, cloud services, cybersecurity, licensing, and technical projects
* Experience maintaining policies, SOPs, audit evidence, or internal control documentation
* ITIL, project management, ISO 27001, compliance, or audit\-related training
* Experience working with international or distributed teams

**Work Arrangement**

This position is currently remote within India.

The company expects to transition to a hybrid or office\-based work environment in 2027\. The selected candidate must be willing and able to report to the future office location when required.

The office location, schedule, and transition timeline will be communicated in advance.

Benefits

* Competitive salary based on experience
* Full\-time, permanent employment
* Remote work during the initial employment period
* Company\-provided laptop and required equipment
* Paid annual leave
* Paid sick leave
* Paid company holidays
* Health or medical benefits based on the final employment package
* Performance reviews
* Professional training and development opportunities
* Exposure to international technology and compliance programs
* Career growth opportunities within Business Operations and Compliance
* Opportunity to help standardize and improve a growing technology organization

**Holidays and Leave**

Employees will receive:

* Paid annual leave
* Paid sick leave
* Company\-observed holidays
* Leave required under applicable Indian employment laws
* An annual company holiday calendar

Final leave allowances, medical benefits, and holiday details will be confirmed in the employment offer.

What This Role Does Not Own

This role does not directly own:

* Accounting, bookkeeping, payments, payroll, or purchase order issuance
* Recruiting decisions, employee relations, or HR investigations
* Technical engineering, help desk support, or system administration
* Sales quotas or client account management
* Executive operational decisions
* Writing every department policy or procedure

The Business Operations and Compliance Specialist supports the COO by maintaining processes, coordinating work, tracking completion, preparing reports, and escalating operational risks.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, process\-oriented, and comfortable working across several departments.

You should be able to take an informal process, document it clearly, track responsibilities, follow up with assigned owners, and provide accurate updates to leadership.

You should also be comfortable supporting compliance requirements without treating the role as only a short\-term audit project.

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by:

* Accurate and current operational workflows
* Timely completion of assigned cross\-department tasks
* Improved client and employee onboarding
* Organized policies, SOPs, and internal documentation
* Progress toward SOC 2 readiness and ongoing compliance
* Accurate weekly and monthly reporting
* Reduction in overdue tasks and recurring operational issues
* Improved accountability across departments
* Complete and organized compliance evidence

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Strong Analytical skills.
  
  

Good Leadership skills with ability to manage large teams

Good communication skills
  
  

A relationship builder
  
Client Satisfaction and cost effectiveness;

**Medewerker HR en Salarisadministratie Betap**  

  

Genemuiden  

28–32 uur per week



Ben jij nauwkeurig, servicegericht en voel jij je thuis in zowel HR als salarisadministratie? Werk je graag in een professionele organisatie waar jij een belangrijke ondersteunende rol vervult voor medewerkers en leidinggevenden? Dan maakt de Condor Group graag kennis met jou!

  

**Over de Condor Group**  

De Condor Group is een toonaangevende producent van textiele vloerbedekking en wereldwijd actief. Met ruim 1\.300 collega’s werken we in een modern, hoogwaardig machinepark aan innovatieve oplossingen voor woningen, kantoren, auto’s, tuinen en sportvelden.  

  

**Over jouw functie**  

Als Medewerker HR en Salarisadministratie ga je in eerste instantie aan de slag bij Betap, een van de bedrijfsonderdelen binnen de Condor Group (ca. 300 medewerkers). In deze veelzijdige functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor de salarisadministratie en ondersteun je daarnaast diverse HR‑processen.  

Je zorgt voor een correcte en tijdige verwerking van salarissen en personeelsgegevens en bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor medewerkers met vragen over salaris, contracten en arbeidsvoorwaarden.  

In de toekomst bestaat de mogelijkheid dat je, afhankelijk van de behoefte en jouw ontwikkeling, ook werkzaamheden verricht voor andere bedrijfsonderdelen binnen de Condor Group. Een mooie kans om jouw expertise breder in te zetten binnen de groep.  

  

**Wat ga je doen?**  

Een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:  

* Verzorgen van een correcte en tijdige salarisadministratie.

**\-** Verwerken van in\-, door\- en uitstroom en overige salarismutaties.  

* Controleren en verwerken van uren uit het urenregistratiesysteem.
* Invoeren en beheren van medewerkersgegevens in HR‑ en salarissystemen.
* Opstellen, aanpassen en beheren van arbeidsovereenkomsten en HR‑documentatie.
* Beheren van personeelsdossiers conform AVG‑richtlijnen.
* Beantwoorden van vragen van medewerkers over salaris, contracten en arbeidsvoorwaarden.

**\-** Contact onderhouden met leveranciers van HR\- en salarissystemen (zoals AFAS).  

* Meedenken over optimalisatie en digitalisering van HR‑ en salarisprocessen.


Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met de HR‑manager, HR‑medewerker en collega HR‑adviseurs binnen de Condor Group.  

  

**Wie ben jij?**  

Wij zoeken een collega met:  

* MBO\+ of HBO werk‑ en denkniveau
* PDL (Praktijkdiploma Loonadministratie) – vereist


\- Ervaring met salaris\- en personeelsadministratie  

* VPS (Vakopleiding Payroll Services) is een pré
* Ervaring met AFAS (HRM/Payroll) is een pré


\- Goede kennis van relevante wet\- en regelgeving  


Persoonlijk ben je nauwkeurig, discreet, servicegericht en zelfstandig. Je houdt overzicht en communiceert gemakkelijk met medewerkers en collega’s.  

  

**Wat bieden wij?**  

* Een afwisselende functie voor 28–32 uur per week
* Werken binnen een professionele en informele HR‑organisatie
* Marktconform salaris
* 25 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime), eindejaarsuitkering en goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden
* Ruimte voor ontwikkeling via opleiding en training

title: Talent Marketing & Digital Experience Specialist
description:
Talent Marketing Digital Experience Specialist
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

The Talent Marketing Digital Experience Specialist will support the management, optimization, and continuous improvement of NTT DATA’s digital talent marketing experiences, with a strong focus on the user experience across the careers site and broader candidate journey.
  
  

This includes careers site content, CMS updates, landing pages, campaign pages, chatbot and Talent Companion experiences, Alumni community and Candidate Concierge management, SEO/search optimization, analytics, and performance reporting.
  
  

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining creativity, digital content, user experience, marketing operations, and technology\-enabled delivery to create engaging, accessible, and effective candidate experiences. The specialist will help translate NTT DATA’s employer brand and talent value proposition into compelling digital experiences that attract, engage, and convert relevant talent.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Careers Site, UX and Digital Experience
  
* Support the day\-to\-day management and optimization of NTT DATA’s careers site and related digital candidate experience platforms.
* Improve the user experience across the careers site by reviewing content structure, navigation, page journeys, accessibility, usability, and candidate engagement points.
* Create, update, and maintain careers site content, campaign pages, landing pages, and other digital talent marketing assets through the CMS.
* Support chatbot, Alumni community and Candidate Concierge, and Talent Companion experiences, including content updates, candidate flows, FAQs, testing, and journey improvements.
* Identify opportunities to reduce friction and improve the candidate experience across the digital talent journey.
* Manage Talent Marketing experiences within the CMS, including templates, careers pages, landing pages, campaign pages, workflows, candidate journeys, and site configurations.
* Work with IT, Phenom support, and relevant platform stakeholders on integrations, releases, enhancements, testing, and system changes that impact Talent Marketing functionality.
* Support localization, translations, content updates, governance standards, quality assurance, and compliance with brand, privacy, legal, and accessibility requirements.


SEO and Content Optimization
  
* Support SEO/search optimization for careers site content, job\-related landing pages, campaign pages, and other talent marketing digital assets.
* Apply SEO best practices, including keyword optimization, metadata, page structure, internal linking, content hierarchy, and search\-friendly copywriting.
* Use search insights and performance data to identify content gaps and optimization opportunities.
* Recommend updates to improve visibility, traffic, engagement, and candidate conversion.


Talent Marketing Campaigns and Content Execution
  
* Build and maintain campaign landing pages and digital content aligned with employer brand messaging and hiring goals.
* Support the development of lead generation initiatives, event promotion pages, and candidate engagement journeys.
* Coordinate campaign assets, tracking links, requirements, approvals, and quality assurance to ensure campaigns are launched on schedule and to standard.
* Ensure campaign content is consistent, locally relevant where needed, and aligned with NTT DATA’s employer value proposition.
* Track campaign performance and recommend improvements based on engagement and conversion data.


Analytics, Reporting and Continuous Improvement
  
* Track and analyze performance across careers site pages, landing pages, campaign pages, chatbot interactions, and candidate journeys.
* Partner with Talent Analytics team to provide regular insights and recommendations on traffic, candidate engagement, conversion, campaign performance, and content effectiveness.
* Ensure accurate campaign tracking, attribution, reporting, and analytics across Talent Marketing initiatives.
* Use data and candidate behavior insights to recommend content, UX, campaign, and SEO improvements.


Stakeholder and Vendor Coordination
  
* Work closely with Global Talent Marketing, Talent Acquisition, PC, IT, regional stakeholders, and external vendors to deliver effective digital candidate experiences.
* Gather stakeholder requirements and translate them into practical digital content, campaign, and experience updates.
* Coordinate timelines, approvals, feedback, dependencies, and delivery of digital talent marketing assets.
* Partner with external platform stakeholders where Talent Marketing activity intersects with CRM workflows, recruitment processes, talent communities, candidate nurture activity, or shared candidate journeys.
* Contribute to a consistent, high\-quality, and globally aligned Talent Marketing experience across regions.


Required Skills and Experience
  
* Experience in Talent Marketing, Recruitment Marketing, Employer Brand, Digital Marketing, Creative Operations, Campaign Operations, Content Management, or Digital Candidate Experience.
* Hands\-on experience managing digital content through CMS platforms.
* Strong writing, editing, and content optimization skills, with the ability to create clear and candidate\-focused messaging.
* Understanding of SEO/search optimization principles and how they apply to digital content and candidate attraction.
* Good understanding of digital user experience principles, including content structure, navigation, accessibility, usability, and conversion\-focused candidate journeys.
* Experience supporting digital campaigns, landing pages, content updates, and candidate engagement journeys.
* Ability to interpret analytics and turn insights into practical recommendations.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple content, campaign, and stakeholder requests.
* Comfortable working with cross\-functional stakeholders in a fast\-moving environment.
* Proactive, organized, and collaborative working style.


Preferred Skills and Experience
  
* Experience with Phenom, chatbot/Talent Companion, recruitment marketing platforms, CRM, marketing automation, or candidate engagement technologies.
* Experience in a global, matrixed, or technology\-driven organization.
* Familiarity with tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Search Console, marketing automation tools, or dashboard/reporting tools.
* Experience supporting talent attraction campaigns.
* Basic understanding of UX writing, accessibility, localization, and content governance.
* Experience working with external vendors or digital platform partners.
* Knowledge of talent acquisition processes and candidate behavior across the hiring journey.


Profile of the Ideal Candidate
  
  

The ideal candidate is a hands\-on digital talent marketing specialist who is creative, detail\-oriented, data\-informed, and comfortable working across content, technology, user experience, and marketing operations. They enjoy improving digital experiences, optimizing content, analyzing performance, and collaborating with stakeholders to deliver high\-quality candidate\-facing experiences.
  
  

They are curious, proactive, and comfortable balancing day\-to\-day execution with continuous improvement. They understand that strong candidate experiences are built through clear content, intuitive journeys, consistent branding, strong usability, search visibility, and ongoing optimization.

title: IT Security Analyst (GRC) (ONLY AGNIVEERS SHOULD APPLY)
description:
**Job Overview**

**\# ONLY AGNIVEERS SHOULD APPLY.**

Fourth Command is looking for a IT Security Analyst (GRC) to join its team in a full\-time role focused on governance, risk, and compliance activities. This position is ideal for a fresher or early\-career candidate who wants to build a career in cybersecurity with practical exposure to GRC platform management, risk assessment, standards mapping, workflow support, API integration coordination, and security documentation.

The selected candidate will support day\-to\-day GRC operations by helping manage platform activities, organizing compliance and risk\-related information, assisting in workflow configuration, supporting documentation, and working with internal stakeholders on security and governance requirements. GRC roles commonly act as the bridge between business processes and security requirements by helping organizations manage risk, maintain compliance, and improve governance practices.

This role is best suited for someone who has a strong interest in cybersecurity governance, attention to detail, and the willingness to learn how security standards, policies, controls, and technology platforms work together in an organizational environment. The role also requires a basic technical mindset, including familiarity with coding concepts and support for platform\-related integrations and process automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the day\-to\-day management and administration of GRC platforms, including maintaining records, updating entries, supporting modules, and helping users navigate platform\-related tasks.
* Assist in conducting risk assessments by identifying risks, documenting observations, tracking remediation items, and supporting the preparation of risk registers and related reports.
* Help map security controls, policies, and internal processes against applicable cybersecurity standards and frameworks.
* Support the documentation and maintenance of major global cybersecurity standards and compliance requirements relevant to the organization, such as:
* ISO/IEC 27001
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF)
* SOC 2
* PCI DSS
* GDPR
* HIPAA
* CIS Controls
* Assist with API integration\-related coordination for GRC or related platforms by supporting technical discussions, documenting integration requirements, validating data flow expectations, and working with technical teams where needed.
* Support workflow creation, updates, testing, and monitoring within the platform to improve process efficiency and task tracking.
* Provide platform support to internal users by helping troubleshoot basic issues, following up on platform tasks, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day usage.
* Prepare, maintain, and organize GRC\-related documentation, including policies, procedures, process notes, evidence records, user guides, control documentation, and audit support material.
* Assist with audit and assessment readiness activities by organizing evidence, maintaining repositories, and supporting follow\-up actions on observations and findings.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure risks, controls, workflow requirements, and documentation needs are properly tracked and updated.
* Support ongoing improvement of governance and compliance processes through structured reporting, documentation quality, and process discipline.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Fresher candidates can apply.
* Bachelor’s degree required in:
* BSc (IT)
* BSc (Cyber Security)
* BSc (Computer Science)
* BCA
* Candidate must have a minimum academic qualification of above 7\.0 CGPA in their qualifying degree.
* Good understanding or academic exposure to cybersecurity, information security, governance, risk, or compliance concepts is preferred.
* Basic awareness of major global cybersecurity standards and frameworks is required, especially ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR, HIPAA, and CIS Controls.
* Understanding of risk assessment concepts, control documentation, and process\-based security work is preferred.
* Basic knowledge of GRC platforms, compliance tools, ticketing systems, or workflow\-based platforms will be an advantage.
* Basic coding knowledge is required, with familiarity in technologies such as Python, React, Node.js, or similar tools useful for platform support, automation, integrations, and technical coordination.
* Understanding of APIs, system integration basics, and data flow concepts will be beneficial for this role.
* Good documentation skills are essential, as the role involves preparing and maintaining process documents, policies, records, and support material.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills are important for working with internal teams and supporting compliance\-related coordination.
* Good analytical thinking, attention to detail, and willingness to learn are important for success in a GRC\-focused role.

**Working Model**

This is a full\-time role with Fourth Command and is suitable for candidates who are comfortable working in a structured professional environment with process\-driven responsibilities. The role may involve regular coordination with internal stakeholders, platform users, technical teams, and compliance\-related functions.

The position is best suited for candidates who are interested in long\-term growth in cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance operations, and platform\-based security process management. Consistency, discipline, and comfort with documentation\-heavy and process\-oriented work will be important in this role.

**Mindset and Commitment**

Fourth Command is looking for a candidate who is sincere, detail\-oriented, and genuinely interested in building a career in cybersecurity with a governance and risk focus. Since this is a junior role, the company will value learning attitude, accountability, and willingness to work patiently on structured tasks such as documentation, risk tracking, platform updates, and workflow support.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, organized, and capable of balancing technical understanding with process discipline. A strong sense of ownership, professional communication, and readiness to learn both business and security requirements will be important for long\-term success in this role.

This position is well suited for someone who wants to grow in the GRC domain by gaining hands\-on exposure to cybersecurity standards, risk assessment, platform management, workflow support, integrations, and security documentation in a professional consulting environment.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

title: IT Security Analyst (ONLY AGNIVEERS SHOULD APPLY)
description:
**Job Overview**

**\#ONLY AGNIVEERS SHOULD APPLY.**

Fourth Command is looking for a IT Security Analyst for a technical cybersecurity role focused on supporting day\-to\-day security operations and helping protect client and internal environments from cyber threats. This role is suitable for a fresher or early\-career candidate who wants to build hands\-on experience in areas such as security monitoring, alert triage, vulnerability management, incident response support, endpoint security, network security, and technical documentation.

The selected candidate will work with the security team to monitor security tools, review alerts, support investigations, assist with vulnerability identification and remediation tracking, and help maintain the effectiveness of security controls across systems and platforms. Junior security analysts commonly support the front\-line technical work of identifying suspicious activity, analyzing security events, and helping improve an organization’s defensive posture.

This role is best suited for a candidate with a strong technical interest in cybersecurity, a willingness to learn hands\-on tools and processes, and a disciplined approach to analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation. The position also requires basic understanding of operating systems, networking, security tools, and coding or scripting concepts that can support automation and operational tasks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor security alerts and events generated by security tools such as SIEM, XDR, antivirus, endpoint protection, IDS/IPS, firewall logs, or related monitoring platforms, and support initial triage of suspicious activities.
* Assist in identifying, analyzing, and escalating security incidents based on severity, impact, and available evidence.
* Support incident response activities by collecting basic information, documenting observations, creating tickets, tracking actions, and coordinating with senior analysts or technical teams during investigations.
* Perform or support vulnerability assessment activities, including reviewing scan results, validating findings, tracking remediation progress, and maintaining vulnerability records.
* Assist in the configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of technical security tools and controls used across endpoint, network, server, cloud, or application environments.
* Review logs, alerts, and system behavior to help identify anomalies, suspicious patterns, or indicators of compromise.
* Support endpoint and system security activities such as patch follow\-up, antivirus status checks, system hardening coordination, access reviews, and compliance with basic security baselines.
* Work with internal teams to raise, track, and follow up on security issues, remediation actions, and operational tasks related to threats, vulnerabilities, or system weaknesses.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation such as incident notes, vulnerability trackers, asset observations, investigation records, standard operating procedures, and security support documents.
* Stay updated on emerging cyber threats, attacker techniques, common vulnerabilities, and security technologies relevant to operational defense and monitoring.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Fresher candidates can apply for this role.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred in:
* BSc (IT)
* BSc (Cyber Security)
* BSc (Computer Science)
* BCA
* Or other related technical backgrounds aligned to information security and systems support.
* Candidate must have a minimum academic qualification of above 7\.0 CGPA in their qualifying degree.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts such as threats, vulnerabilities, malware, phishing, endpoint security, network security, and incident handling is required.
* Familiarity with technical security domains such as SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, firewall basics, antivirus, log analysis, or IDS/IPS will be an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of networking concepts such as IP addressing, ports, protocols, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, VPN, and firewalls is important for this role.
* Basic understanding of Windows, Linux, endpoints, user access, and system\-level security controls is preferred.
* Basic coding or scripting knowledge is required, with familiarity in Python, PowerShell, Bash, Node.js, React, or related technologies being useful for automation, tool support, integrations, and technical troubleshooting.
* Awareness of vulnerability scanning, remediation tracking, and technical issue documentation will be beneficial.
* Good analytical thinking, troubleshooting ability, and attention to detail are important for monitoring and incident support work.
* Good written and verbal communication skills are required for documentation, reporting, and coordination with technical teams.

**Working Model**

This is a full\-time technical cybersecurity role with Fourth Command and is suitable for candidates who are comfortable working in a structured operational environment. The role may require continuous coordination with internal security teams, technical teams, and project stakeholders for monitoring, investigation support, remediation follow\-up, and security operations activities.

The position is ideal for candidates who want practical exposure to technical cybersecurity work and are interested in building long\-term careers in security operations, threat monitoring, vulnerability management, detection engineering support, or incident response. The role demands consistency, focus, and readiness to learn tools, processes, and technologies used in real\-world cyber defense environments.

**Mindset and Commitment**

Fourth Command is looking for a candidate who is technically curious, disciplined, and committed to learning cybersecurity through hands\-on operational work. Since this is a junior role, the company will value sincerity, willingness to learn, strong observation skills, and the ability to follow structured security processes carefully and responsibly.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, alert, and comfortable working with logs, alerts, systems, and technical observations. A strong sense of ownership, timely escalation, professional communication, and a genuine interest in technical cybersecurity will be important for success in this role.

description:
**About the Role**

While our Travel Advisors design the dream holiday, our **Operations Executive** makes it happen. You will be the engine room of Yatriko, turning confirmed itineraries into flawless real\-world travel experiences.

This role is perfect for a highly organized, detail\-oriented individual who loves coordination, problem\-solving, and ensuring everything runs smoothly behind the scenes. If you are a fresher with strong execution skills or have up to 3 years of travel operations experience, we will provide the training and mentorship you need to succeed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Booking Execution:** Process and confirm all bookings for flights, hotels, ground transportation, and sightseeing tours with suppliers and vendors.
* **Voucher \& Document Management:** Generate, verify, and dispatch accurate travel vouchers, itineraries, travel insurance policies, and welcome kits to clients before departure.
* **Supplier Coordination:** Maintain daily communication with local and international vendors, hoteliers, and destination management companies (DMCs) to ensure services are locked in.
* **Visa Assistance:** Coordinate the documentation, filling, and processing of tourist visas for clients, ensuring strict adherence to timelines.
* **Real\-Time Trip Support:** Act as the backbone for our on\-trip clients, coordinates solutions swiftly if a hotel check\-in issue, flight delay, or logistical challenge arises.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **Experience:** 0 to 3 years of experience. Freshers with a degree/diploma in Tourism, Aviation, or Management are highly welcome.
* **Attention to Detail:** Absolute precision is key. A single wrong date or spelling mistake can disrupt a trip; we need someone who double\-checks everything.
* **Communication Skills:** Strong verbal and written communication in English and Hindi to coordinate effectively with global suppliers and team members.
* **Tech \& Typing Speed:** Quick at learning internal software, navigating B2B portals, and managing spreadsheets (MS Excel/Google Sheets).
* **Problem\-Solving Mindset:** Calm under pressure and resourceful when resolving unexpected travel changes.

**What We Offer**

* Comprehensive training on international B2B portals, booking systems, and visa processing.
* A transparent career progression path from executive to operations manager.
* A vibrant, professional, and supportive workspace in Ahmedabad.
* Competitive base salary with performance\-based bonuses.

**How to Apply**

If you are highly organized and want to build a career in the operational side of the global travel industry, we want to hear from you.

* **Email Your Resume:** Send your CV directly to **hr@yatriko.com** with the subject line *"Application: Operations Executive \- Ahmedabad"*.

Akanksha works primarily in the field of education, addressing formal education by initiating school reform through its School Project. Currently, Akanksha reaches out to the 9300 children through its 21 schools in Mumbai and Pune.

title: Junior Electronics Engineer
description:
**Junior Electronics Engineer – Bedrock Foundry (Onsite, Kozhikode)**

**About the Company**

Bedrock Foundry is a technology\-driven company building scalable and reliable software and hardware systems. We focus on high\-performance engineering, clean architecture, and modern hardware\-software integration.

**About the Role**

We are hiring a brilliant, hands\-on **Junior Electronics Engineer** to join our hardware engineering team in Kozhikode. This is a full\-time, onsite role designed for freshers, dedicated electronics hobbyists, and entry\-level engineers (0 to 1 year of experience) who love working at the circuit level. If you spend your free time designing custom PCBs, soldering components, and making microcontrollers communicate with hardware sensors, you will fit right in.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Schematic \& PCB Design:** Assist in designing, routing, and reviewing schematic diagrams and multi\-layer Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs) for custom hardware modules.
* **Hardware Testing \& Debugging:** Use laboratory tools (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers) to bring up new boards, trace signals, and troubleshoot hardware failures or signal noise.
* **Prototyping \& Soldering:** Hand\-solder surface\-mount technology (SMT) and through\-hole components onto prototype boards with precision.
* **Component Selection:** Research and source electronic components, verify datasheets, and maintain clean Bills of Materials (BOM) for manufacturing.
* **Firmware Collaboration:** Work hand\-in\-hand with software and robotics engineers to test hardware peripherals and ensure seamless integration with microcontrollers.

**What You’ll Gain**

* True hands\-on experience taking hardware designs from an empty schematic sheet all the way to a manufactured, functional physical product.
* Deep technical mentorship from senior system engineers on signal integrity, power management, and noise reduction.
* **Free Company Benefits:** Comfortable accommodation, daily meals, and a premium gym membership to ensure a seamless relocation to Kozhikode.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 0–1 year of electronics hardware experience (**Freshers with a strong portfolio of personal or academic hardware projects are highly encouraged to apply**).
* **Education:** B.Tech / BE / Diploma in Electronics \& Communication (ECE), Electrical \& Electronics (EEE), Mechatronics, or equivalent practical hardware background.
* **Core Skills:** Solid understanding of analog/digital circuit design fundamentals, power regulation (LDOs, buck\-boost converters), and communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART).
* **Mindset:** Extreme attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a genuine passion for physical electronics craftsmanship.

**Preferred Qualifications (Bonus Points)**

* High proficiency with modern PCB design tools like **KiCad, Altium Designer, or Autodesk Fusion Electronics**.
* Exceptional bench skills (clean manual soldering of 0603/0402 components and small IC packages).
* Basic exposure to microcontroller programming (C/C\+\+ in Arduino IDE, ESP\-IDF, or STM32Cube) to write quick test firmware scripts.

**Job Details**

* **Location:** Onsite – Kozhikode, Kerala
* **Job Types:** Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher
* **Schedule:** Day shift

**How to Apply**

If you are fascinated by hardware architecture, love diagnosing circuit boards down to the trace, and want to build cutting\-edge physical systems, apply now to join Bedrock Foundry.

Important: Please include a link to a portfolio file, a GitHub hardware repository, or high\-quality photos/videos showcasing the schematics, PCB layouts, or physical circuit boards you have personally designed and built. Applications highlighting real hardware projects will be prioritized.

**Work Location:** In person

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

**About Us**

SchoolSetu by Cognitive Smart Solutions is a WhatsApp\-first automation platform that helps schools handle attendance queries, report card distribution, fee collection, and parent announcements — all through a single WhatsApp number parents already use. No app downloads, no login friction, just “Hi” and a menu.

**Role Overview**

We're looking for a part\-time, field\-driven Business Development Executive to onboard schools onto SchoolSetu. This is a high\-ownership, incentive\-led role — you identify schools, pitch and demo the product, close the deal, and earn a direct share of what you bring in.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and build a pipeline of target schools (private/CBSE/ICSE/international schools, school chains, education trusts)
* Reach out to principals, administrators, and trustees via cold visits, calls, email, and referrals
* Pitch SchoolSetu's value: reduced front\-office workload, faster fee collection, 24x7 parent self\-service via WhatsApp
* Run live product demos of the parent journey (attendance, report cards, fee payment, announcements)
* Negotiate and close deals as per the standard pricing model
* Coordinate with the onboarding team to ensure smooth go\-live for each signed school
* Maintain accurate pipeline and visit records, and share regular updates with the founder/BDM
* Represent SchoolSetu at local school events, expos, or principal meets as opportunities arise
* Consistently work toward the monthly onboarding target to remain eligible for the allowance

**Compensation Structure**

* Allowance: Rs 5,000/month for travel and telephone/communication expenses — contingent on meeting the monthly target.
* Commission: Flat 50% of the first month's subscription fee for every school onboarded
* *Example: A school with 200 students onboards at Rs 10,000/month subscription → you earn Rs 5,000 commission for that deal.*
* Commission payout timing: Released only once the school's first subscription payment has actually cleared — not on signing or agreement alone
* No cap on the number of schools onboarded — earnings scale directly with your closures

**Contract Terms**

* Initial contract: 3 months
* Extension beyond 3 months based on performance (targets met, pipeline quality, engagement)
* Part\-time role — flexible hours, but consistent field activity expected to meet monthly targets

**Requirements**

* Strong communication and pitching skills, especially with school administrators/principals
* Comfortable with a field\-based role — visiting schools directly in your local area
* Own conveyance (two\-wheeler) preferred for local travel
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working in a target\-linked, commission\-based, part\-time structure
* Basic familiarity with WhatsApp, smartphones, and simple reporting (Excel/Google Sheets)
* Prior sales/field experience preferred but not mandatory — freshers with strong communication skills welcome to apply

**What We Offer**

* Flat 50% commission on every school onboarded, paid once payment clears — no cap on earnings
* Monthly travel \+ telephone allowance on hitting target
* Flexible, part\-time working hours
* Training on product pitch, demo flow, and objection handling
* Opportunity for contract extension and growth into a larger role based on performance

title: Marketing Program Manager
description:
Read this fully before applying. This role isn't for everyone.

We're an AI startup building a virtual try\-on platform for fashion brands globally. Our customers are apparel brands across the US, UK, Canada, and India. We're small, fast, and growing — and we're looking for one person to help run our marketing engine.

**This is an ownership role, not a desk job.** You'll run real marketing from day one, guided by a founder who has already built and successfully exited a technology company. Most people never get this kind of direct, close\-range mentorship this early in their career. Here, it's the job.

**What you'll do**

You'll own work across our core channels — and go deep where you're strongest:

* Plan, schedule, and publish content across LinkedIn, X, and Instagram
* Execute our SEO program — blog content, rankings, backlinks, directory listings
* Track campaign metrics and keep the whole program organized and on time
* Grow into paid ads (Google, Meta, LinkedIn) as you build the fundamentals
* Manage GTM end\-to\-end

You'll have a documented playbook and weekly mentorship. You're improving a system that already works — not guessing alone.

**Who thrives here**

* 0–2 years in digital marketing, or a strong fresher with real projects to show
* Genuinely organized — you juggle many moving parts without dropping them
* A sharp writer who can make an idea land in two sentences
* A self\-starter who moves fast, measures results, and improves without being told

**Who should not apply:** anyone looking for a slow, predictable 10\-to\-6\. The pace here is real and the standards are high. We reward it with growth most roles can't offer.

**Why it's worth it**

* Real ownership from day one — you run the work, not shadow it
* Rare, direct mentorship from a proven founder while you own your channels
* Fast growth: prove yourself in the first months and step into a senior, full\-time mandate with more scope and pay
* You'll understand how a global product actually goes to market — a skill that compounds for your whole career

**₹20,000–25,000/month**, based on experience and demonstrated skill.

**To apply:** Send your CV plus 5–6 sentences answering this — *pick any fashion brand you like and tell us one specific thing you'd do to get more people to discover it.* We read every response, and it matters more than your resume.

title: Technical Writer
description:
**About DevRev**
 At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
 *Computer* 
 – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
 *Computer* 
 unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI\-ready platform, giving employees real\-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI\-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human\-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M\+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
   

  

**About The Role**
 DevRev’s Knowledge team is hiring a technical writer who has strong technical proficiency and strives for simplicity. You’ll join a small team that has built our external documentation set from scratch and ships on a rapid product cadence. This role reports to the Head of Knowledge Ops.The Technical Writer is responsible for ensuring that documentation for our product is useful, findable, clear, correct, comprehensive, and consistent \- and that it directly contributes to customer self\-service and product adoption.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Write, review, publish, and maintain product documentation on the support portal, covering features across our AI product (Computer), platform capabilities (access control, customization, connectors), and integrations (Salesforce, Jira, Zendesk, etc.).
* Ensure documentation is available at launch and then deepen, expand, and improve it over time based on customer needs, support patterns, and product evolution. Sustaining documentation is as much of the job as creating it.
* Partner with product managers who own the content for their areas. Your job is to help them get documentation ready: structuring, drafting, editing, publishing, and driving the review process to completion on schedule.
* Identify and address knowledge base gaps by analyzing support ticket themes, deflection data, and customer feedback \- not waiting for requests to arrive.
* Maintain and improve the documentation infrastructure: contribute to article health metrics, flag platform issues that affect KB quality (e.g., metadata hygiene, article visibility settings), and propose operational improvements.
* Hold subject\-matter experts accountable for technical reviews. Documentation at DevRev is a cross\-functional commitment: product managers own accuracy, and you drive the process that ensures it.
* Identify and implement opportunities to use AI and automation to scale documentation production, including AI\-assisted drafting, content audits, and workflow automation.


**What You'll Bring**
* 3 \- 6 years writing and maintaining software product documentation, preferably for SaaS or platform products.
* Strong command of documentation best practices: information architecture, essentialism, clear and direct prose.
* Experience sustaining a documentation set over time \- not just writing first drafts, but iterating, expanding, consolidating, and retiring content as products evolve.
* Comfortable with knowledge base platforms, markdown, and version\-controlled content workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to learn complex technical domains quickly \- AI, APIs, integrations, access control, and similar concepts will be your daily vocabulary.
* Effective async communicator across time zones.
* Interest in using AI tools to augment documentation workflows for drafting, translation, content audits, or summarization.


**Strongly Preferred**
* Previous startup experience, demonstrating adaptability and proactivity in fast\-paced environments.
* Familiarity with AI products, developer tools, or platform products with complex permission models.
* Experience using analytics (article views, search queries, deflection rates) to prioritize documentation work and measure impact.


*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

title: Global Finance & Operations Associate – Risk Operations
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As a member of the Global Finance \& Operations Services (GF\&OS) team based in the Global Services New Delhi hub, you'll play an important role in supporting BCG's global Risk \& Compliance operations. You'll provide operational support for compliance processes by managing requests and inquiries, monitoring global compliance activities, and helping ensure the timely execution of key risk and compliance initiatives.

  

Working closely with Global Risk \& Compliance teams and stakeholders across multiple regions, you'll help coordinate compliance\-related activities, maintain accurate operational records, support reporting and data validation, and contribute to continuous improvements that strengthen BCG's global compliance operations.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage shared Risk \& Compliance mailboxes, including DPO, Data Subjects, and Anti\-Bribery \& Corruption (ABC), ensuring requests are processed accurately and within agreed service levels.
* Review, prioritize, and route incoming compliance requests, escalating complex or high\-risk matters to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Coordinate follow\-up activities with HR Business Partners, Practice Area teams, Regional Compliance Leads, and other stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of compliance actions.
* Monitor and report on global compliance initiatives, including mandatory training campaigns and operational metrics.
* Maintain accurate documentation of requests, resolutions, escalations, and compliance activities to support governance and audit requirements.
* Prepare regular and ad hoc operational reports, providing insights into request volumes, response times, compliance trends, and process performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, enhance mailbox management, and strengthen compliance workflows.
* Support data validation, reporting, and operational activities while ensuring compliance with BCG policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

  

What You'll Bring

**EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Law, Risk Management, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification is a plus.
* One to three years of experience in finance operations, risk, compliance, governance, operations, or a related business support function.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess operational data, identify trends, and recommend practical improvements.
* Excellent attention to detail and sound judgment when handling sensitive and confidential information.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across global teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, adapt to changing business needs, and deliver high\-quality work in a fast\-paced environment.
* A collaborative, customer\-focused mindset with curiosity, initiative, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

  

Who You'll Work With


You'll be part of the Global Finance \& Operations Services (GF\&OS) team based in the Global Services New Delhi hub, working closely with BCG's Global Risk \& Compliance organization. In this role, you'll collaborate with colleagues across Global Risk \& Compliance, HR, Practice Area teams, Regional Compliance Leads, and other cross\-functional partners to support global compliance operations.


Reporting to the Global Finance \& Operations Senior Manager, you'll work in a collaborative, team\-oriented environment focused on delivering high\-quality operational support, driving continuous improvement, and helping strengthen BCG's global risk and compliance processes.

  

Additional info

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

 **Risk Operations \& Compliance Support**

* Managing operational requests and compliance inquiries with accuracy, responsiveness, and attention to detail.
* Supporting compliance processes through effective mailbox management, case tracking, and timely follow\-up activities.
* Maintaining accurate records and documentation to support governance, reporting, and audit requirements.
* Building foundational knowledge of global risk and compliance processes, systems, and operational workflows.
* Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
* Monitoring operational performance through reporting, analysis, and compliance metrics.
* Identifying trends and opportunities to improve operational efficiency and strengthen compliance processes.
* Supporting data quality, validation, and reporting activities to ensure reliable operational information.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Building effective working relationships with Global Risk \& Compliance teams and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Communicating clearly and professionally while managing multiple priorities and responding to operational requests.
* Exercising sound judgment and maintaining confidentiality when handling sensitive information.

**Ways of Working**

* Managing competing priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and accountability.
* Demonstrating initiative, ownership, and a proactive approach to resolving operational issues.
* Adapting to changing priorities while contributing to a collaborative, customer\-focused team environment.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

This role requires a strategic thinker with excellent communication skills who can deliver under pressure with tight timelines.
 



  





**Detailed responsibilities of the role.** 




  





**Compensation** 




  




* Analyze compensation data and analysis and generate actionable insights to support pay decisions; create executive ready business cases on competitiveness of compensation programs.
* Evaluate market competitiveness through detailed market benchmarking and create pay ranges using data from market surveys for accurate job matches and internal equity. Using a balance approach between organization affordability and market competitiveness.
* Act as an expert and own end to end delivery of global processes such as Annual Compensation Cycle using simulations for merit and bonus distribution and work with business leaders. Work with HRSS \& payroll for generation of letters and processing of payroll.

* Partner with global stakeholders and proactively manage communications that can impact the global organization.
* Governance of all TR related policies and process and
* Manage any adhoc projects related to total rewards



  





**Benefits** 



* Manage development and implementation of benefits as Group benefits plans, wellness initiatives, flexible allowances etc. Partner with external brokers/vendors to negotiate benefits renewal.
* Drive assessment of current benefits relative to the external market and ensure the benefits programs remain market competitive and aligned to statutory requirements.
* Providing advisory on benefits programs, policies \& guidelines.



  





  





**What you need to have:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, masters preferred.
* **8\+ years of experience in human resource with a strong focus on market benchmarking, benefits design and implementation, running annual merit increment cycles.**
* **At least 5\+ years’ experience in total rewards.**
* Proven experience of working on large datasets and generating insights.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with business leaders and hr partners.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience in a similar industry will be an added advantage.
* Experience of working on compensation related tools such as Mercer Win, Bettercomp, Marketpay.
* Ability to multitask and work under tight deadlines while maintaining consistent quality and adherence to process / policy.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Good influencing skills.



**What makes you stand out?** 



* Exceptional communication skills
* Out of the box thinking
* Attention to detail



**Why join our team:** 



* We help you to be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and create an impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well\-being.



  





 Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit corporate.marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
 



 Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
 



 Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office\-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.
