title: HR Manager - Shared Services
description:
**About Bikham Healthcare \& Provider Passport** 




  





 Bikham Healthcare is a 20\-year\-old US and India\-based healthcare company operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and automation. The company has deep expertise in provider credentialing, insurance enrollments, and revenue cycle management for healthcare organizations across the United States.
 



  





 Today, Bikham is entering an exciting phase with the growth of its AI\-powered platform, Provider Passport, which is designed to automate healthcare administration and significantly reduce provider onboarding timelines. Provider Passport is expected to onboard major health systems in the United States, positioning Bikham as a growing healthcare technology company.
 



  





 This role sits within Bikham Healthcare and functions as a shared HR service across both business units — Bikham Healthcare's services business and the Provider Passport platform team. You will own people operations for the combined organization rather than a single business line, giving you visibility across the full breadth of the company.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 Fixed US night shifts 7pm \- 4am
 



 Weekends fixed off
 



  





 We are seeking a seasoned HR Manager to build, manage, and continuously strengthen people operations across both Bikham Healthcare and Provider Passport as the combined organization grows across international markets. You will lead the HR function end\-to\-end — talent acquisition oversight, employee relations, HR policies and compliance, performance management coordination, and organizational culture development — as a shared service supporting both business units, across the US and India.
 



 This is both a strategic and hands\-on role. You will build HR systems and processes that work across two business units and two countries, while also supporting employees and leadership on day\-to\-day people matters regardless of which team they sit on. The ideal candidate brings strong India\-based HR operations experience with exposure to US hiring, compliance, and global workforce management, and will work closely with the founders and leadership team to help both Bikham Healthcare and Provider Passport build a high\-performance, growth\-oriented, and positive work culture.
 



 If you're an HR leader who can operate strategically with executive leadership one moment and handle a hands\-on employee relations issue the next — across two connected but distinct business units — this role is for you.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. HR LEADERSHIP \& DEPARTMENT MANAGEMENT** 




 ●       Lead and manage the entire HR function as a shared service across both Bikham Healthcare and Provider Passport
 



 ●       Build HR systems that support growth and international operations for both business units
 



 ●       Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership on people strategy and organizational development across the combined organization
 



  





**2\. TALENT ACQUISITION OVERSIGHT** 




 ●       Oversee the talent acquisition team and ensure efficient, high\-quality hiring processes for both Bikham Healthcare and Provider Passport roles
 



 ●       Participate directly in recruiting senior and specialized roles, including US\-based positions, for either business unit
 



 ●       Ensure both business units attract high\-quality talent aligned with the company's culture and growth plans
 



  





**3\. HR POLICIES, SOPs \& EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK** 




 ●       Design and implement HR policies, SOPs, and organizational procedures that apply consistently across both business units
 



 ●       Develop and maintain employee handbooks and HR documentation covering staff at both Bikham Healthcare and Provider Passport
 



 ●       Ensure HR practices remain compliant with India \& US labor regulations, aligned with global standards, and maintain a working knowledge of US compliance requirements
 



  





**4\. EMPLOYEE RELATIONS \& HR SUPPORT** 




 ●       Act as the primary HR point of contact for employees, regardless of which business unit they sit on
 



 ●       Address employee concerns, queries, and workplace issues professionally and fairly
 



 ●       Foster a shared workplace culture built on transparency, trust, and communication across both teams
 



  





**5\. PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT COORDINATION** 




 ●       Participate in designing and implementing a holistic Performance Management system for the Company
 



 ●       Conduct monthly check\-ins and surveys with department heads at Bikham Healthcare and Provider Passport to assess team performance
 



 ●       Collect and analyze feedback on employee and departmental performance across the combined organization
 



  





**6\. EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT \& CULTURE BUILDING** 




 ●       Design and implement employee engagement initiatives and programs that serve both business units, adapting for team\-specific needs
 



 ●       Build initiatives that support a positive, growth\-oriented workplace culture across the shared organization
 



 ●       Introduce programs that enhance employee motivation, satisfaction, and retention company\-wide
 



  





**7\. HR COMPLIANCE \& GOVERNANCE** 




 ●       Ensure compliance with India \& US labor laws and HR best practices across both business units
 



 ●       Maintain structured HR records and documentation, organized by business unit where required
 



 ●       Support leadership in maintaining a transparent and compliant HR environment for both Bikham Healthcare and Provider Passport
 



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




**Education** 




 ●       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field
 



 ●       MBA in HR or equivalent preferred
 



  





**Experience** 




 ●       7\+ years of experience in Human Resources leadership roles
 



 ●       Current or last 2 years working in US/ night shifts
 



 ●       Strong experience managing HR operations in India
 



 ●       Familiar with US hiring practices and global workforce environments
 



 ●       Experience overseeing recruitment teams and HR systems
 



  





**Skillset** 




 ●       Strong understanding of HR policies, compliance, and organizational development
 



 ●       Experience designing HR SOPs, policies, and employee handbooks
 



 ●       Excellent communication and conflict resolution skills
 



 ●       Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational HR work
 



 ●       Strong leadership and team management capabilities
 



  





**Mindset** 




 ●       Ownership: You treat the HR function's health — policies, compliance, culture — as your responsibility, not a checklist
 



 ●       Trusted Advisor: You earn the confidence of founders and employees alike, and are sought out for judgment, not just process
 



 ●       Culture Builder: You see employee engagement and workplace culture as something to design deliberately, not something that happens on its own
 



 ●       Fair and Discreet: You handle sensitive employee matters with professionalism, consistency, and confidentiality
 



 ●       Globally Minded: You're comfortable operating across India and US HR norms simultaneously, and know where they differ
 



  





**HR \& Global Workforce Knowledge** 




 ●       Deep working knowledge of India labor law, statutory compliance, and HR governance
 



 ●       Working familiarity with US hiring practices and baseline US employment compliance
 



 ●       Experience building and maintaining employee handbooks, HR SOPs, and organizational policy documentation
 



 ●       Comfortable coordinating performance management processes across departments and geographies
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




  





**In 30 Days** 




 ●       Full audit of current HR policies, SOPs, employee handbook, and compliance posture complete, with a prioritized list of gaps
 



 ●       Strong working relationship established with the executives and department heads; you understand how the organization actually operates day to day
 



 ●       Baseline understanding of the talent acquisition team's process and current open roles
 



 ●       Immediate employee relations or compliance risks identified and a remediation plan underway
 



  





**In 90 Days** 




 ●       Updated or newly built employee handbook and core HR policies in place and communicated to the organization
 



 ●       Performance management check\-in cadence with department heads established and running consistently
 



 ●       At least one employee engagement initiative launched, with a clear rationale tied to retention or culture goals
 



 ●       Talent acquisition process reviewed and refined, with measurable improvement in hiring efficiency or quality
 



  





**In 12 Months** 




 ●       A scalable, well\-documented HR function is in place across US and India operations, serving both Bikham Healthcare and Provider Passport, with compliance risk minimized in both geographies
 



 ●       Employee engagement and retention have measurably improved across both business units, with programs in place that the organization can point to
 



 ●       Leadership at both Bikham Healthcare and Provider Passport relies on you as the go\-to partner for people strategy, not just HR administration
 



 ●       The shared HR function is positioned to scale smoothly as both Bikham Healthcare and Provider Passport continue to grow
 



  





**What We Offer** 




  





**Direct Access to Leadership** 




 This role will work closely with founders Harman Dhawan (CEO) and Sonia Dhawan (Managing Partner) and will play a key role in shaping the company's people strategy.
 



  





**Build the HR Foundation of a Growing Company** 




 This role offers the opportunity to strengthen HR systems, policies, and culture across two connected business units — Bikham Healthcare and Provider Passport — as the combined organization enters a strong growth phase.
 



  





**Entrepreneurial Leadership Culture** 




 Bikham encourages initiative, creativity, and ownership. High\-performing team members often grow faster than they would in traditional corporate environments.
 



  





**Modern Remote Work Environment** 




 Bikham operates as a fully remote organization, allowing team members to work from home while collaborating with teams and clients across the United States and internationally.

title: Associate Director, Global People Services and Help Desk (Bangkok Based -Relocation provided)
description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The People Team at Agoda is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent from across the globe. We work to create an inclusive, high\-performing, and engaging environment where employees can grow, contribute meaningfully, and do their best work. Through a strong focus on people experience, service quality, and business partnership, we help Agoda scale while preserving what makes our culture distinctive.
   

  

 Within the People Team, the
 **People Experience and Services** 
 function is responsible for designing and delivering critical people experiences, services, and operating foundations that support employees and managers across the employee lifecycle. This includes enabling smooth onboarding and mobility experiences, delivering effective workplace and office services, and ensuring employees have access to timely, trusted, and high\-quality support when they need it.
   

  

 At the center of this model sits
 **People Services \& Help Desk** 
 — Agoda’s front door for People support — supported by specialist service teams such as
 **People Relations Services** 
 . Together, these teams play a critical role in how employees and managers experience the People function day to day: through clear guidance, responsive support, effective issue resolution, and trusted handling of sensitive people matters.
   

  

**Opportunity**
 We are looking for an
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk** 
 to lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People service delivery model across
 **People Help Desk / Tier 1 support** 
 ,
 **Tier 0 / self\-service foundations** 
 , and
 **Global People Relations Services** 
 .
   

  

 This is a key leadership role within People Experience and Services, responsible for shaping how employees and managers access support across a wide range of People topics — from day\-to\-day HR questions and lifecycle support to more complex and sensitive employee matters requiring specialist intervention.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the teams responsible for:
   

  

* People Help Desk / Tier 1 services
* Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge foundations
* Global People Relations Services, including case governance and specialist support for complex employee relations matters


 You will own the effectiveness of Agoda’s People support model from the employee and manager perspective, ensuring it is clear, trusted, scalable, and increasingly insight\-driven. This includes strengthening service standards, improving routing and handoffs across teams, enabling greater self\-service, and ensuring sensitive employee matters are handled with appropriate quality, consistency, and governance.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a leader who combines strong service delivery and operational leadership with sound judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to build a modern, scalable People support model in a global, fast\-moving organization.
   

  

 This position is based in
 **Bangkok** 
 . Agoda provides relocation support for successful candidates who are not currently located in Bangkok. Please note that we are
 **not open to remote work** 
 or the possibility of being based in other locations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Lead Agoda’s People Services front door and employee support model**
* Lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People Services model across Tier 1 Help Desk support, Tier 0 self\-service, and the interface into specialist support teams.
* Define and evolve how employees and managers access support across People topics, ensuring a clear, seamless, and trusted experience.
* Establish strong service principles, operating rhythms, and leadership across the teams responsible for day\-to\-day People support and complex employee issue resolution.
* Ensure Agoda’s People support model scales effectively with organizational growth, complexity, and global reach.


**Lead the People Services \& Help Desk team**
* Lead, manage, and develop the People Services \& Help Desk team to deliver high\-quality, consistent, and empathetic Tier 1 support across core HR topics such as policies, processes, employee data, benefits, onboarding, leaves, mobility, and general employee lifecycle support.
* Set service standards, KPIs, quality expectations, and operating controls to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant case handling.
* Build a strong service culture with clear accountability for employee experience, right\-first\-time resolution, responsiveness, and professionalism.
* Oversee workforce planning, capacity management, and prioritization across service demand, seasonal peaks, and new People initiatives.


**Lead Global People Relations Services**
* Lead the Global People Relations Services team, ensuring high\-quality and well\-governed support across complex employee matters such as performance concerns, misconduct, grievances, investigations, disciplinary actions, involuntary exits, and employee matters arising from organizational change.
* Ensure clear service ownership, escalation pathways, and governance across People Relations case handling.
* Partner closely with HR Business Partners, Legal, Compliance, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure people relations matters are handled fairly, consistently, pragmatically, and in line with internal policies and local legal requirements.
* Drive high standards in case management, documentation, risk identification, and decision quality across the People Relations team.
* Use case trends and themes to inform improvements in manager guidance, policy design, service processes, and broader practices.


**Own the operating interfaces across Tier 1, People Relations, and specialist teams**
* Serve as the senior operational owner for how work flows between Help Desk / Tier 1, People Relations Services, and other Tier 2 / specialist teams across the People organization.
* Define and continuously improve routing logic, escalation models, intake criteria, handoffs, service ownership, and resolution pathways.
* Ensure employees and managers experience a joined\-up service model even when multiple People teams are involved.
* Clarify roles and interfaces across Help Desk, People Relations, Payroll, Rewards, Mobility, People Partners, CoEs, and other specialist teams.


**Build Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge management foundations**
* Develop and execute Agoda’s roadmap for Tier 0 / self\-service, moving the organization toward more proactive, intuitive, and self\-directed resolution of common People queries.
* Own and strengthen the People knowledge ecosystem, including FAQs, help content, decision trees, agent guidance, and employee\-facing support materials.
* Partner with policy owners and People SMEs to simplify complex topics into clear, scalable, and user\-friendly content.
* Drive case deflection, knowledge reuse, content governance, and self\-service adoption through disciplined measurement and continuous improvement.


**Enable digital, conversational, and AI\-supported service delivery**
* Partner with Product, Tech, Systems, and Data teams to improve People support platforms, workflows, and user journeys across self\-service and case management.
* Identify and help shape practical use cases for conversational and agentic AI within People Services, ensuring they enhance employee experience and complement human support.
* Provide leadership input into the design, testing, rollout, and continuous refinement of AI\-enabled and digital service solutions.
* Ensure appropriate controls, privacy, escalation paths, and trust mechanisms are in place for all digital and AI\-supported support channels.


**Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement**
* Monitor and improve key service performance metrics across Help Desk and People Relations Services, such as case volume, first contact resolution, time to resolution, service quality, customer satisfaction, escalation rates, re\-open rates, and self\-service deflection.
* Lead ongoing improvements in workflows, playbooks, standard responses, training, quality assurance, and reporting.
* Partner with People Service Excellence and other stakeholders to simplify processes, remove friction, and improve end\-to\-end employee and manager experiences.
* Ensure effective controls, compliance, documentation standards, and data privacy practices are embedded across service operations.


**Lead through insight, stakeholder partnership, and change**
* Act as the senior People Services contact for service performance, priorities, risks, and transformation opportunities.
* Provide regular insight and reporting to People leaders on service trends, root causes, organizational pain points, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with Communications and relevant People teams to coordinate messaging around policy changes, process updates, and new tools or services.
* Support broader People transformation by bringing an employee\-service lens to operating model design, simplification, and capability building across the function.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Operations, Law, Psychology, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
* Typically, 10\+ years of relevant experience across HR shared services, employee services, People operations, employee relations, HRBP, service delivery, or related functions, including significant leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers and/or multiple service teams in a complex, matrixed, and fast\-paced environment.
* Strong experience running a service or support function with clear accountability for quality, responsiveness, service design, and stakeholder experience.
* Strong understanding of multi\-tier service delivery models, including Tier 0 / self\-service, Tier 1 support, and specialist / Tier 2 case management.
* Meaningful exposure to employee relations or complex people issue resolution, with sound judgment on sensitive matters and a strong appreciation for governance, risk, and consistency.
* Strong skills in service design, operating model improvement, process improvement, and cross\-functional workflow design.
* Experience with HR technology platforms and service tools such as HRIS, case management systems, knowledge bases, and digital support tools.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and analytics to monitor performance, identify themes and root causes, and drive prioritization and decision\-making.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence across leaders, specialist teams, and cross\-functional partners.
* Strong people leadership capability, including coaching leaders and managers, building team capability, and creating a high\-performance, service\-oriented culture.
* Comfort operating in a global, evolving, and ambiguous environment, with a strong bias for execution, improvement, and scale.


**It’s great if you also have**
* Experience in a global or regional HR shared services / People services environment.
* Experience leading both broad employee support teams and specialist employee relations or case management teams.
* Experience in knowledge management, service content strategy, and self\-service adoption.
* Hands\-on exposure to conversational AI, chatbots, virtual assistants, or workflow automation in HR or customer support environments.
* Experience improving employee experience through service redesign, process simplification, or digital product thinking.
* Experience in a high\-growth tech, internet, or digital business.
* Familiarity with global organizations operating across multiple countries, cultures, and regulatory environments.


**Why this role matters**
 This role is a unique opportunity to shape how Agoda employees and managers experience People support at scale. From everyday HR queries to more complex and sensitive employee matters, the teams in this scope play an important role in making sure our people feel supported, informed, and able to navigate key moments in their Agoda journey with confidence.
   

  

 As
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk**

title: Global HR Shared Services Assistant
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. You will be a key member of our Global HR Shared Services Center (HRSSC), supporting regional and local HR teams and employees worldwide with administrative HR processes. Key responsibilities include:

* Preparing and processing employee paperwork for new hires, promotions, transfers, exits, and changes.

* Managing employee documentation requests including verification letters, references, and visa invitation letters.
* Delivering reporting on employee data (e.g. distribution lists, anniversaries, milestones).
* Supporting internal audits with required documentation and timely response.
  

What You'll Bring

* Proficiency in German – C1/C2 (both spoken and written) is essential, as this role involves supporting Germany.
* A full\-time graduation degree.
* \~1–3\+ years of relevant experience in HR operations, HR shared services, or a process\-driven role.
* Familiarity with Workday (preferred) or other HR ERP systems.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word, Visio).
* Experience working in a professional services or multinational environment.

  



  

  

Additional info

**You’re Good At**

* Thriving under pressure with exceptional attention to detail.
* Staying flexible and reliable in a dynamic and changing environment.
* Managing multiple tasks with structure and discipline.
* Handling sensitive data with confidentiality and professionalism.
* Communicating clearly and professionally, both in writing and speech.
* Creating meaningful experiences for every customer through exceptional service.
* Collaborating across cultures and time zones.

Ranked among the Top 1% Shopify stores in India, we are bootstrapped, profitable, and scaling rapidly with industry\-leading benchmarks.  We are looking for a Business Analyst who is passionate about solving business problems through data, structured thinking, and execution. * Track and monitor key business KPIs such as Revenue, Conversion Rate, CAC, ROAS, AOV, Inventory Health, Return Rate, and Customer Retention.

* Help implement workflow automations, ERP improvements, and reporting automation wherever possible.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timely availability of reports across departments.
* Support business reviews by presenting insights, trends, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Continuously improve reporting processes and identify opportunities to simplify business decision\-making through data.


**WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?**
* 1\+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, MIS, Reporting, Operations Analytics, or similar roles.
* Strong proficiency in Advanced Excel / Google Sheets (Pivot Tables, Lookups, Advanced Formulas, Data Cleaning).
* Hands\-on experience with SQL for data extraction and analysis.
* Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation.

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present data in a simple and actionable manner.
* High ownership mindset and the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment.

* Do you believe numbers tell stories that can drive better decisions?
* Are you excited to work across multiple business functions and influence business growth?
* Do you like simplifying complex problems through structured thinking and analysis?
* Are you curious about how a fast\-growing D2C brand scales using data and technology?

 At सादा / SAADAA, we believe that great businesses are built by people who combine curiosity, ownership, and simplicity with data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

**WHAT DO WE OFFER?**
* Exposure to high\-impact business decisions across multiple functions.
* Opportunity to work directly with founders and leadership.
* Ownership of business\-critical projects and analytics.
* A fast learning environment with real business impact.
* Competitive compensation based on skills and experience.
* A culture that values simplicity, ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for an AI Engineer with a strong background in backend software engineering, cloud environments, and MLOps. This role is focused on the engineering side: building, integrating, and deploying generative AI systems.
   

  

 This is a entry level position. You will work alongside our senior engineers and architects to turn AI prototypes into reliable, production grade cloud applications. If you have solid software development skills, a DevOps mindset, and want to learn how to build scalable agentic workflows and optimize LLM systems on GCP, we would love to meet you.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Build AI Applications: Help write, test, and deploy production ready GenAI applications. You will play a key role in taking prototypes and agentic workflows and turning them into stable enterprise services.
* Integrate GenAI Workflows: Build and maintain backend pipelines for generative AI under the guidance of senior team members. This includes working on Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, multi\-agent frameworks, and semantic search.
* Support MLOps Pipelines: Help build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for ML models and LLM applications. You will set up basic logging, tracing, and monitoring tools to make sure our production models are healthy and performing well.
* Optimize Inference and Performance: Help scale and optimize model inference on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to keep latency low, control cloud costs, and handle high throughput.
* Manage Data and Feature Pipelines: Develop and maintain data processing setups, including clean data pipelines and embedding pipelines that connect to vector databases and GCP data tools.
* Use Modern Developer Tools: Actively use AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot or Cursor to write clean code, speed up your development cycle, and build thorough automated testing suites.
* Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with our internal math experts, senior MLOps architects, and business stakeholders to translate business ideas into practical, working software features.


 What We Are Looking For
   

  

* Strong Software Fundamentals: Solid experience with Python and clean backend software engineering practices (such as object\-oriented design, writing APIs, and working with microservices).
* Cloud and DevOps Basics: Hands\-on experience with GCP (such as Cloud Run, GKE/Kubernetes, and BigQuery) or equivalent cloud providers. You should be comfortable with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and the basics of infrastructure as code.
* Experience with GenAI Tools: Practical exposure (through work, school, or personal projects) to working with foundation model APIs like Gemini, OpenAI, or Anthropic. Familiarity with frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or the Google ADK is a big plus.
* Data and Databases: Experience with standard database technologies, and a strong interest in learning how to work with vector databases like BigQuery Vector Search.
* An Observability Mindset: A basic understanding of how to monitor applications, log performance, and track operational metrics in production.
* Strong Desire to Learn Financial Markets: You do not need to be a financial expert on day one, but you should have a strong analytical mind and a genuine interest in learning how commodity and financial derivative markets work.


**CME Group: Where Futures are Made**
 CME Group is the world’s leading derivatives marketplace. But who we are goes deeper than that. Here, you can impact markets worldwide. Transform industries. And build a career by shaping tomorrow. We invest in your success and you own it – all while working alongside a team of leading experts who inspire you in ways big and small. Problem solvers, difference makers, trailblazers. Those are our people. And we’re looking for more.
   

  

 At CME Group, we embrace our employees' unique experiences and skills to ensure that everyone’s perspectives are acknowledged and valued. As an equal\-opportunity employer, we consider all potential employees without regard to any protected characteristic.
   

  

**Important Notice:** 
 Recruitment fraud is on the rise, with scammers using misleading promises of job offers and interviews to solicit money and personal information from job seekers. CME Group adheres to established procedures designed to maintain trust, confidence and security throughout our recruitment process. Learn more here.

title: Machine Learning Scientist I - Customer Technology
description:
Who we are
   

  

 Wayfair is moving the world so that anyone can live in a home they love – a journey enabled by more than 3,000 Wayfair engineers and a data\-centric culture. The Customer Technology (CT) team builds and owns machine learning products that power search, marketing, personalization, and recommendations across Wayfair.. Our algorithms tackle a varied \& broad spectrum of challenges in the Wayfair marketplace; from empowering suppliers to easily add products to our catalog, to enabling our customers to discover and purchase a vast \& diverse assortment of home goods, to driving marketing experiences customers love all at web scale.
   

  

 We are looking for machine\-learning scientists for research and development of the ML systems that power our Customer understanding and personalization systems \- Customer embeddings, Recommendation systems, user interest prediction, generative recommendation systems, short term and long term customer preference identification. In this role, you’ll partner with fellow scientists, engineers, analysts, and product managers to apply machine learning skills to directly impact Wayfair’s revenue.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Design, build, deploy and refine large\-scale machine learning/AI models and algorithmic decision\-making systems that solve real\-world problems for customers
* Work cross\-functionally with engineers, analysts, product managers and commercial stakeholders to understand business problems, opportunities and develop appropriately scoped ML solutions
* Collaborate closely with various infrastructure, and ML platform teams to develop production grade services that follow best\-practices in how we build and deploy scalable ML services
* Build cutting edge robust ML models and systems that directly impact our customers every day
* Identify new opportunities and insights from the data (where can the models be improved? what is the projected ROI of a proposed modification?)
* Be obsessed with the customer and maintain a customer\-centric lens in how we frame, approach, and ultimately solve every problem we work on
* This is an introductory position meant to help you start your career in Machine learning and AI.


 What you’ll need
   

  

* Master’s or a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field with 1\-2 years of industry experience.
* Proficiency in Python or one other high\-level programming language.
* A strong theoretical understanding and solid hands\-on experience working with machine learning algorithms.
* Classical ML and deep learning techniques across NLP, sequence modeling, RL, Recommendation systems, clustering, and time series.
* Experience with Python ML ecosystem (numpy, sklearn, pytorch, XGBoost, etc.)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, ability to synthesize conclusions for non\-experts, and overall bias towards simplicity and efficiency
* Intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm about continuous learning


 Nice to have
   

  

* Designing end\-to\-end ML solutions from prototype to production.
* Experience in deploying ML workflows/models in production system

* Familiarity with cloud based compute approaches GCP (or AWS, Azure), ML model development frameworks, and ML orchestration tools (Airflow, Kubeflow, VertexAI, etc)

description:

 CI/CD automation, Docker, monitoring, scripting, and production support. The candidate will work closely with senior
   

  

 DevOps engineers, architects, development teams, QA teams, and security teams to implement and maintain reliable
   

  

 delivery pipelines and cloud environments.
   

  

 Strong Linux, Docker, CI/CD, cloud, automation, and troubleshooting skills are mandatory. Kubernetes and GitOps
   

  

 exposure will be considered good to have rather than a mandatory requirement.
   

  

**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
  Understand project requirements, deployment processes, operational KPIs, and environment\-specific expectations.
   

  

  Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines for build, testing, security checks, artifact management, deployment, and rollback.
   

  

  Support application deployments across development, testing, staging, pre\-production, and production environments.
   

  

  Work with development teams to resolve build, dependency, configuration, runtime, and deployment issues.
   

  

  Manage and troubleshoot Linux servers and cloud\-hosted infrastructure.
   

  

  Create, optimize, secure, and troubleshoot Docker images and containers.
   

  

  Develop automation scripts using Shell/Bash and Python.
   

  

  Provision and manage infrastructure using Terraform and Ansible under the guidance of senior team members.
   

  

  Configure and maintain application monitoring, infrastructure monitoring, centralized logging, dashboards, alerts, and notification channels.
   

  

  Configure custom alerts for application and infrastructure health in AWS and Azure.
   

  

  Troubleshoot deployment failures, server issues, container failures, application logs, network connectivity, storage issues, and configuration problems.
   

  

  Perform structured root cause analysis for incidents and recurring operational issues.
   

  

  Support corrective and preventive actions following incidents.
   

  

  Assist with patching, upgrades, backups, restore checks, certificate renewals, and preventive maintenance.
   

  

  Support secret management, credential updates, password rotation, access management, and certificate renewal activities.
   

  

  Follow cloud security, least\-privilege access, infrastructure security, and compliance practices.
   

  

  Support vulnerability, dependency, container, secret, and Infrastructure as Code scanning activities.
   

  

  Monitor resource utilization, application health, capacity, deployment status, and operational cost.
   

  

  Maintain deployment guides, infrastructure documentation, runbooks, SOPs, and operational checklists.
   

  

  Provide regular progress and incident updates to senior team members and management.
   

  

  Collaborate with distributed teams, customers, developers, QA teams, and support teams.
   

  

  Use AI\-assisted tools effectively for troubleshooting, automation, scripting, documentation, and productivity.
   

  

  Be willing to work in the EST time zone or provide significant overlap with EST business hours.
   

  

**Required Technical Skills**
**Linux Administration**
  Strong hands\-on experience with Linux server administration.
   

  

  Experience managing users, groups, permissions, processes, services, logs, disk and memory utilization, package installation, scheduled jobs, and network configuration.
   

  

  Working knowledge of SSH, systemd, cron, log rotation, and Linux security practices. Docker and Containerization
   

  

  Strong hands\-on experience with Docker and Dockerfiles.
   

  

  Experience with multi\-stage builds and Docker image optimization for size, build time, performance, and security.
   

  

  Ability to troubleshoot startup failures, networking, volumes, environment variables, build failures, resource constraints, and application\-runtime issues.
   

  

** Experience With Docker Compose Is Preferred.**
**CI/CD**
  Hands\-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
   

  

  Experience with one or more of GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Bitbucket Pipelines, AWS CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, or CodePipeline.
   

  

  Understanding of build automation, automated testing, security scanning, artifacts, secrets handling, deployment approvals, release management, and rollback procedures.
   

  

  Ability to identify and improve slow, unreliable, or repetitive pipeline stages.
   

  

**Infrastructure as Code and Scripting**
  Working knowledge of Terraform and Ansible.
   

  

  Strong Shell/Bash scripting skills.
   

  

  Basic to intermediate Python scripting skills.
   

  

  Ability to automate deployments, backups, monitoring, housekeeping, and routine infrastructure administration.
   

  

**Cloud Administration**
  Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform, preferably AWS or Azure.
   

  

  AWS exposure may include EC2, ECS, ECR, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, Route 53, ELB, CloudFront, CloudWatch, EventBridge, Systems Manager, Secrets Manager, and CI/CD services.
   

  

  Azure exposure may include Azure DevOps, Virtual Machines, Container Registry, Storage, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics Workspace, Application Insights, networking, Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Front Door, Managed Identities, and RBAC.
   

  

  Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform or Linode will be considered an added advantage.
   

  

**Monitoring, Networking, Security, and Git**
  Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, LogAnalytics Workspace, Application Insights, New Relic, Datadog, ELK/OpenSearch, or Loki.
   

  

  Understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, firewalls, routing, load balancers, reverse proxies, TLS, VPNs, and public/private networking.
   

  

  Ability to use troubleshooting tools such as curl, ping, traceroute, nslookup, dig, ss, netstat, telnet, and openssl.
   

  

  Understanding of IAM, RBAC, least privilege, secrets management, credential rotation, patching, backups, and disaster recovery.
   

  

  Strong working knowledge of Git, branching, merge or pull requests, reviews, tags, releases, conflicts, rebase, cherry\-pick, protected branches, and access controls.
   

  

**Application Troubleshooting**
  Ability to understand application logs, configuration files, dependencies, build processes, and runtime behavior.
   

  

  Working exposure to applications developed in Python, PHP, Java, Node.js, Ruby, or similar technologies.
   

  

  The role is not an application\-development position, but the candidate should be able to identify infrastructure, configuration, dependency, and runtime\-related issues.
   

  

**Technologies We Are Looking For**
  Operating systems and containers: Linux, Docker, and Docker Compose.
   

  

  CI/CD platforms: GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Bitbucket Pipelines, and AWS CodeBuild/CodeDeploy/CodePipeline.
   

  

  Cloud platforms: AWS and/or Microsoft Azure; Google Cloud Platform and Linode exposure is advantageous.
   

  

  Infrastructure automation: Terraform, Ansible, Shell/Bash, and Python.
   

  

  Monitoring and logging: Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics Workspace, New Relic, Datadog, ELK/OpenSearch, and Loki.
   

  

  Source control and collaboration: Git, GitLab, GitHub, Bitbucket, and Jira.
   

  

  Security and DevSecOps: Trivy, SonarQube, OWASP ZAP, Gitleaks, Snyk, Checkov, secrets management, IAM, and RBAC.
   

  

  Web, database, and middleware technologies: Nginx, Apache, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
   

  

  Good\-to\-have container orchestration and GitOps: Kubernetes, Helm, Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Argo CD, and FluxCD.
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
  Exposure to Kubernetes and container orchestration.
   

  

  Basic understanding of Pods, Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Ingress, Persistent Volumes, and Namespaces.
   

  

  Experience deploying or troubleshooting applications on Kubernetes.
   

  

  Exposure to Helm charts, resource requests and limits, autoscaling, Kubernetes networking, storage, and monitoring.
   

  

  Familiarity with Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service, Google Kubernetes Engine, or Linode Kubernetes Engine.

 The Site Reliability Engineer I (SRE I) ensures our production services remain available, scalable, and efficient on Google Cloud Platform. You will bridge the gap between development and operations by applying software engineering mindsets to containerized infrastructure challenges. This entry\-level role focuses on GitOps application deployments via ArgoCD, alert triage, Grafana Labs observability, and leveraging AIOps platforms, backed by strong OS and networking knowledge.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* GitOps \& Deployments: Deploy, roll back, and manage the lifecycle of containerized applications using ArgoCD pipeline workflows.
* Alert Triage \& Resolution: Act as the first line of defense to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve infrastructure, OS\-level, application, and network alerts.
* Network Troubleshooting: Diagnose connectivity and latency issues across all network layers, isolating problems between cloud VPCs and Kubernetes overlays.
* OS Troubleshooting: Diagnose deep Operating System bottlenecks including CPU throttling, memory leaks, and storage constraints on GKE worker nodes.
* AIOps Utilization: Use AI\-driven operations tools to interpret correlated events, anomaly detections, and automated root\-cause insights.
* Incident Response: Participate in on\-call rotations, using Grafana dashboards and AIOps suggestions to quickly mitigate production container issues.


**Required Technical Skills:**
* CI/CD \& GitOps: Practical experience deploying and managing applications using ArgoCD and Git version control systems.
* Networking: Comprehensive knowledge of all layers of networking (OSI model), with practical troubleshooting skills in Layer 7 (Application): HTTP/S, DNS, gRPC, and SSL/TLS handshakes ; Layer 4 (Transport): TCP/UDP mechanics, three\-way handshakes, and port allocation; Layer 3 (Network): IP routing, CIDR blocks, Subnetting, and ICMP; Kubernetes Networking: Understanding of Pod\-to\-Pod communication, Services, Ingress controllers, and CNI plugins.
* Operating Systems: Strong, deep foundational knowledge of Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, or Container\-Optimized OS) internals, process management, file systems, and kernel parameters.
* System \& Network Utilities: Proficiency with command\-line diagnostic tools (e.g., tcpdump, curl, dig, traceroute, top, iostat).

* Orchestration: Functional knowledge of deploying, scaling, and managing workloads in GKE.
* ML/AIOps (nice to have ) : Anomaly detection concepts , log\-based ML models

**Soft Skills \& Qualifications:**
* Problem Solving: Ability to systematically troubleshoot complex microservice and OS\-level issues under pressure.
* Urgency \& Prioritization: Strong sense of ownership and ability to prioritize alerts based on business impact.
* Analytical Mindset: Comfort working alongside data\-driven, automated recommendations to solve infrastructure problems.
* Communication: Clear written and verbal communication during high\-stress incident responses.

description:
**Who are we**
 Fulcrum Digital is an agile and next\-generation digital accelerating company providing digital transformation and technology services right from ideation to implementation. These services have applicability across a variety of industries, including banking \& financial services, insurance, retail, higher education, food, healthcare, and manufacturing.
   

**Position Overview**

 The SOC Analyst – Offshore is responsible for real\-time monitoring, triage, and analysis of security events across the organization’s IT environment. The role focuses on identifying potential threats, escalating incidents, and supporting incident response activities to ensure the security and integrity of systems and data.
   

  




**Key Responsibilities**
**Monitoring \& Detection**
* Monitor security alerts and events using SIEM platforms and other security monitoring tools.
* Validate, prioritize, and fine\-tune alerts to reduce false positives and maintain effective SOC operations.
* Conduct routine health checks of SOC tools and promptly report anomalies.


**Incident Triage \& Investigation**
* Perform initial triage, classification, and severity assessment of security incidents.
* Review system, network, and application logs to identify suspicious activities.
* Conduct basic endpoint analysis using EDR tools.
* Enrich event data using internal and external threat intelligence sources.


**Incident Response**
* Execute predefined incident response playbooks and adhere to standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Escalate incidents to higher\-tier analysts with complete, accurate, and well\-documented case notes.
* Communicate incident updates and status to the SOC team in a timely manner.


**Documentation \& Reporting**
* Document all investigative actions, findings, and recommendations in the ticketing or case management system.

title: Systems Engineer (Offshore Wind Substation Projects)
description:
**Position Summary** 




 The Systems Engineer will support the design, integration, and delivery of offshore wind substation (OSS) projects, working across electrical, structural, mechanical, and automation domains. The role ensures that system\-level requirements are captured, interfaces are properly managed, and the substation operates reliably and safely throughout its lifecycle.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **System Design \& Requirements**
* Develop and maintain system\-level requirements and specifications for OSS topsides and support structures.
* Assist in system architecture, interface definitions, and design integration across HV equipment, auxiliary systems, and SCADA/telecom.
* Perform engineering calculations, simulations, and load flow/power system studies.
* **Integration \& Interfaces**
* Support coordination between HV equipment suppliers, structural/marine engineers, and automation teams.
* Track and resolve technical issues, ensuring alignment across packages (WTG, array cables, export cables, onshore connection).
* Maintain the
 **interface register** 
 and ensure traceability of requirements.
* **Testing \& Validation**
* Contribute to factory acceptance tests (FAT), system integration tests (SIT), and offshore commissioning.
* Support verification of system performance, reliability, and compliance with standards.
* **Compliance \& Documentation**
* Ensure designs meet
 **DNV, IEC, ISO, and grid operator requirements** 
 .
* Prepare technical documentation including specifications, reports, and risk assessments.
* Participate in design reviews with certifying bodies and clients.
* **Project Support**
* Work closely with project engineers, package leads, and system managers to meet project milestones.
* Support bid/proposal inputs with technical data and feasibility checks.



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 



* **Education** 
 : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical/Power Systems Engineering, Offshore/Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
* **Experience** 
 :
* 3–7 years in power systems, offshore wind, oil \& gas, or HV substation projects.
* Knowledge of HV equipment (GIS, transformers, switchgear, cables), protection \& control, and auxiliary systems.
* Familiarity with offshore engineering standards (DNV\-ST\-0145, IEC 61892, ISO 19900 series).
* **Technical Skills** 
 :
* Proficiency in modeling tools (ETAP, DIgSILENT, PSCAD, MATLAB/Simulink).
* Understanding of SCADA, automation, and telecom systems in offshore environments.
* **Soft Skills** 
 :
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical ability.
* Effective communication and collaboration in multi\-disciplinary, international teams.
* Ability to work in fast\-paced EPC/EPCI project environments.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Timely delivery of assigned engineering deliverables.
* Accuracy and completeness of system requirements and documentation.
* Effective resolution of interface and integration issues.
* Compliance with technical standards and project quality requirements.
* Positive feedback from project leads, certifying bodies, and clients.

description:
**Summary:**



 Client is seeking a Network Engineer to design, deploy, and operate the corporate and datacenter network infrastructure that supports our global workforce and production environments. You will manage the full lifecycle of networks, enhancing reliability, security, and scalability. This role involves collaboration with Security, IT, and Cloud Engineering teams and the use of AI tools for troubleshooting, documentation, and automation.
 




**Responsibilities:**
* **Corporate \& Campus Networking:** 


	+ Design and maintain the corporate LAN, including access/distribution/core switching, VLANs, STP, and QoS for headquarters and remote offices.
	+ Manage and optimize the wireless LAN infrastructure, including site surveys, RF planning, SSID design, and client troubleshooting.
	+ Administer 802\.1X network access control, certificate\-based authentication, and guest network segmentation.
* **Datacenter Networking:** 


	+ Operate and evolve the datacenter network, including spine\-leaf architecture, BGP, VxLAN/EVPN overlays, and high\-availability designs.
	+ Ensure network stability and performance by monitoring capacity and latency baselines.
	+ Collaborate with engineering teams on connectivity, service deployments, and capacity expansions.
* **Security \& Firewall:** 


	+ Manage Palo Alto Networks NGFW platforms, including security policy, App\-ID, URL filtering, Threat Prevention, and WildFire integration.
	+ Administer GlobalProtect VPN and Prisma Access for remote access and enforce zero\-trust network segmentation.
	+ Conduct firewall rule reviews and support periodic security audits.
* **Reliability \& Automation:** 


	+ Monitor network health using observability tools and drive resolution of incidents and root\-cause analyses.
	+ Develop and maintain automation scripts and workflows to reduce operational toil and improve consistency.
	+ Use AI\-assisted tools for log analysis, runbook generation, and network documentation.

* 6 years of hands\-on enterprise network engineering experience.
* Proficiency with Palo Alto Networks NGFWs and Panorama, including security policy management and VPN.
* Solid understanding of routing and switching fundamentals: BGP, OSPF, STP/RSTP, VLANs, LACP, and L2/L3 design.
* Experience designing and supporting enterprise wireless networks and familiarity with 802\.11ax/Wi\-Fi 6\.
* Working knowledge of datacenter networking concepts such as spine\-leaf architecture, VxLAN/EVPN, and high\-availability failover.
* Strong troubleshooting methodology and effective communication skills.
* Relevant certifications such as PCNSE, CCNP Enterprise, CWNA/CWSP, or equivalent.


**Required Skills:**

title: Network Engineer
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



**Job Description:** 




  

 We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer to join our global team and help
   

 design, implement, and maintain our private and public cloud infrastructure.
   

 This role involves contributing to the maintenance and operation of network
   

 components, with a focus on building smart, scalable, and easy to maintain
   

 automated solutions.
   

 The ideal candidate has experience working in a large\-scale enterprise or
   

 global cloud service provider network, with strong knowledge of networking
   

 principles, and an understanding of networking in AWS, GCP and Azure. They
   

 should also be comfortable working in a Linux environment, and proficient at
   

 network automation and using configuration management and automation
   

 tools such as Git and Ansible. They will possess a good awareness of the
   

 network and communications ecosystem and of emerging technologies.
 



**Key Responsibilities:**
  Deploy, configure, maintain, troubleshoot and optimize network
   

 infrastructure.
   

  Collaborate with senior engineers, architecture and engineering teams to
   

 implement network requirements and support organisational objectives.
   

  Collaborate with external vendors and partners to maintain and continue
   

 to improve the network.
   

  Contribute to network automation initiatives through the implementation
   

 of scalable and intelligent automation solutions.
   

  Participate in an on\-call rotation to ensure the stability and availability of our
   

 critical infrastructure.
 



  

**Required Skills \& Experience:**
  3\+ years of experience in a network engineering role, ideally within a large\-
   

 scale enterprise or cloud service provider network.
   

  Strong knowledge of and working experience with network routing,
   

 switching, and firewalling.
   

  Experience with modern data center network topologies such as spine\-and\-
   

 leaf and overlay networks.
   

  Solid understanding of networking principles and concepts, including
   

 working knowledge of common protocols such as Ethernet, IP (v4 and v6\),
   

 TCP, UDP, DNS, IPsec, BGP, VXLAN, EVPN, and HTTPS.
   

  Good proficiency in network security, and experience working with NGFW
   

 firewalls.
   

  Good understanding of public cloud environments (Direct Connect, transit
   

 gateway, VPCs, gateway etc.).
   

  Strong Grafana proficiency: building and maintaining custom metric
   

 exporters and integrating externally provided exporters; designing
   

 dashboards; and managing alerting configuration as code, deployed via
   

 Terraform.
   

  Experience with VPN technologies.
   

  Network virtualisation such as VRFs and VXLAN.

 Qualcomm’s Audio Systems and R\&D team is seeking a talented and highly motivated engineer specializing in the implementation of Digital Signal Processing (DSP) algorithms and Machine Learning (ML) models for next\-generation in\-vehicle audio experiences. * Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills.

* Masters or PhD in Electronics and Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science (with Signal Processing coursework or experience), or a related field (or equivalent work experience).


****Preferred Skills:****
* Knowledge of automotive infotainment systems and their audio stack.
* Familiarity with noise reduction, echo cancellation, audio enhancement, Zonal Voice

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
**Embedded Systems Engineer** 




**Embedos Engineering LLP \| Mumbai, India** 




**Full\-time \| On\-site** 




  





**About Embedos** 




  





**Embedos builds Industrial IoT hardware and software for factories. Steel, cement, pharma, automotive, food processing. Our product lines include Field Devices, Cloud Dashboards, Interface Software, Hardware based AI Models and customized solutions.** 




  





**What This Role Is** 




  





 You will design, build, and debug embedded hardware and firmware that operates inside industrial plants.
 



  





 This means schematics, PCB layout reviews, firmware on microcontrollers and Linux SBCs, communication protocol integration, and field deployment support.
 



  





 You will work across the full chain from circuit design to production firmware.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Design schematics and review PCB layouts for industrial edge devices.
* Write firmware in C / Python on Micro Controller / Linux platforms.
* Implement and debug communication protocols: RS\-485, Modbus RTU, CAN/J1939, UART, SPI, I2C.
* Develop RTOS\-based applications with real\-time constraints.
* Integrate sensors, actuators, and IO modules into working systems.
* Work on Linux\-based embedded platforms: device drivers, hardware interfacing, kernel\-level optimization where needed.
* Design isolated IO, power supply sections, and protection circuits for industrial environments.
* Support production testing, field commissioning, and on\-site debugging.
* Collaborate with the software team on data contracts, MQTT telemetry, and OTA update flows.



  





**Must\-Have** 



* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics and Telecommunication, Electronics, or Instrumentation.
* Strong C/C\+\+ on bare\-metal and RTOS environments.
* Hands\-on experience reading datasheets, drawing schematics, and debugging with oscilloscope and logic analyzer.
* Working knowledge of at least two industrial communication protocols (RS\-485, Modbus, CAN, SPI, I2C, UART).
* Understanding of power supply design, signal conditioning, and PCB design considerations for noise and EMI.
* Experience with at least one microcontroller family (ESP32, STM32, or equivalent).



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with ESP\-IDF / STM / Nordic ( RISC V) frameworks.
* Familiarity with Linux kernel modules or device tree configuration.
* Exposure to KiCad / Altium / Eagle for PCB design.
* Understanding of industrial safety and protection standards.
* Prior work in factory or plant environments.
* Exposure to MQTT, OTA mechanisms, or fleet management concepts.

title: Associate Product Manager - Lokal Jobs App
description:
**About Lokal:**
 In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier\-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.
   

  

 This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight \- when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

 Today, Lokal is a
 **house of focused apps,** 
 many products, one mission:
   

  

 to connect Tier\-2/3\+ India to the
 **Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts** 
 they've always deserved.
   

  

 We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
   

  

* Edutainment \& Skill Learning \- practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking \- hyperlocal, compatibility\-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* Agri Consulting \- farmer\-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs \- blue\- and grey\-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* Social \& Community \- Place to find \& post social updates (Lokal app)
* Emotional Well\-being \& Peer Support \- safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt \& Eaze)
* Astrology \& Guidance \- instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* Advisory Services \- early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more


 Under the hood, Lokal is a
 **discovery and access platform** 
 : local\-language internet \+ deep Bharat insight\+ AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
   

  

 This is the story new teammates walk into:
   

  

 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre —
 **access changes lives** 
 .
   

  

**We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.**
 We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 We are looking for a Product Manager with 1\+ years of experience, preferably from a startup environment, who can own product initiatives end\-to\-end and drive data\-backed product decisions. The ideal candidate should have strong SQL skills and experience working in fast\-paced, high\-growth teams.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Responsibilities:**
* Define product vision, roadmap, and feature priorities
* Gather business and user requirements and convert them into PRDs
* Analyze product performance using SQL and data to identify opportunities
* Work closely with Engineering, Design, Business, Operations, and Marketing teams to deliver product improvements
* Track key product metrics and optimize user experience
* Drive feature launches, experimentation, and post\-launch analysis
* Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure timely execution and business impact


**What We're Looking For:**
* 
* 1\+ years of Product Management experience
* 
* Strong SQL skills with the ability to analyze large datasets
* 
* Prior experience in a startup or high\-growth environment
* 
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills
* 
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies
* 
* Hands\-on experience with project/documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence
* 
* Familiarity with product analytics tools


**Benefits**
* At Lokal, we act like owners who take initiative beyond job descriptions, get things done despite obstacles, and maintain a growth mindset focused on learning. We're outcome\-driven with bias for action, believing speed matters in building products for billion Indians. Decision\-making involves open debate followed by full commitment, and we operate on context rather than control \- managers share the "why" while you own execution. We aim to be an all\-star team that thinks big and takes calculated risks to achieve ambitious goals
* Be part of a fast\-growing startup with 100M\+ downloads and a footprint across 1000\+ towns \& 250\+ districts \- huge scope for impact and learning
* Opportunity for fast growth, professionally and personally, as you help expand into new areas and build things from scratch.
* Access comprehensive benefits, including insurance coverage, generous leave policies, ESOP buybacks, flexible work\-from\-home options, and more

* Basic understanding of app store processes (iOS/Android) App development

 AI\-Enabled Delivery Excellence
   

  

* Leveraging AI tools to improve delivery insights, sprint forecasting, risk identification, and team productivity.

 Full\-time

 5\+ years total; minimum 2 years in a BA or analyst role

 Fully Remote

 Product Delivery / Engineering Operations

 CEO

 None
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 Revmind Labs AI is a boutique deep\-tech AI company building production\-grade AI and software systems for enterprise customers, especially in pharma and CPG. We build tailored AI solutions, advanced analytics platforms, dashboards, data workflows, AI/LLM\-powered systems, and enterprise\-ready applications that move from idea to production.
 



  





 We are looking for a Business Analyst \& Scrum Master to support the Engineering Manager and CEO in running structured sprint delivery. In the near term, you will assist with Scrum facilitation, documentation, and functional testing. The expectation is that you grow into independently managing Scrum on future projects.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* **50%** 
 Sprint \& Documentation Support — Assist in managing the Jira board; author and maintain BRDs and TRDs in Confluence; write user stories, acceptance criteria, and help keep the backlog groomed and sprint\-ready.
* **20%** 
 Scrum Operations — Update task assignments, statuses, and story points in Jira in line with daily Scrum calls; support the Engineering Manager in keeping ceremonies and artefacts on track.
* **10%** 
 Sprint Reporting — Prepare structured sprint reports at the close of each sprint covering velocity, burn\-down, blockers, and delivery outcomes.
* **20%** 
 Functional Testing — Write and execute functional test cases for each sprint increment; log defects in Jira and verify fixes before sign\-off.



  





**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATION** 




  




* 5\+ years of total professional experience, with at least 2 years in a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar analyst role.
* Working knowledge of Jira — boards, backlogs, epics, story points, and basic reporting.
* Experience writing BRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria in a software delivery environment.
* Exposure to Scrum or Agile delivery — you have participated in ceremonies and understand the framework.
* Comfortable working independently in a fully remote setup.
* Enough technical literacy to work alongside an engineering team, ask the right questions, and document accurately — without needing to write code.



  





**PREFERRED ADDITIONAL SKILLS** 




  




* Certified Scrum Master (CSM or PSM).
* Experience with Confluence for documentation.
* Familiarity with SQL or data querying.
* Exposure to AI, analytics, or enterprise SaaS product environments.



  





**TOOLS AND PLATFORM EXPOSURE** 




  





**Sprint \& Project Management :** 
 Jira
 



**Documentation :** 
 Confluence
 



**Communication :** 
 Slack, Google Meet, or equivalent
 



**Testing :** 
 Functional test case execution; defect logging in Jira
 



  





**COMPENSATION, BENEFITS AND GROWTH** 




  





 Compensation will be up to 15 LPA.
 



  





 For India\-based candidates, benefits may include:
 


* Fully remote and flexible working arrangement — results and delivery matter, not hours or location.
* Paid time off, sick leave, and applicable Indian public holidays.
* Health insurance support or medical benefits, provident fund, depending on employment structure and company policy.
* Learning and upskilling support for relevant product delivery, Scrum, BA, and testing areas.
* Home\-office, equipment, or software support where applicable to the role.
* Unusual growth opportunity as Revmind Labs AI scales its product, engineering culture, delivery standards, and GTM\-stage trajectory.
* A serious builder environment with high ownership, direct feedback, low ego teamwork, and meaningful problems.



  





**CAREER GAPS AND NON\-LENEAR PATHS** 




  





 Career gaps or non\-linear paths are not a problem. If you have taken a break for personal, family, health, caregiving, relocation, layoff\-related, professional, or other reasons, that will not count against you by default. We care more about what you can deliver now, how you think, how you learn, how you handle feedback, and how you work with others.

title: Technical Writer
description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
   

  

 Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever\-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
   

  

**About The Position**
 The Technical Writer is part of the Information Management team and plays a pivotal role in bridging the gap between potentially complex technical information and the end users who need to understand and use it. They are responsible for creating clear and concise documentation such as production, maintenance and laboratory procedures, safety procedures, equipment manuals, and training materials. Their expertise lies in translating potentially intricate technical concepts into accessible language, ensuring that all content is accurate, up\-to\-date. Collaborating closely with engineers, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders, Technical Writers ensure the integrity of the documentation, which is critical for the safe and efficient operation of LNG facilities..
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintenance of all facility production, maintenance and laboratory Operating Procedures, Work Instructions and Process \& Equipment Manuals, as well as HSE and Process Safety Manuals and Reports.
* Generate materials with input from SMEs and ensure that all documents are developed for their intended audience.
* Research engineering documentation, diagrams, corporate standards, and other regulations and standards to ensure sufficient compliance.
* Ensure that impact from MOCs, HAZOPs and other ABU processes are adequately captured and reflected in all affected documents.
* Ensure technical documents adhere to industry standards including Human and Organisation Performance (HOP) principles


**About You**
 5\+ years of relevant experience providing technical writing support and for a Complex Processing Facility (CPF) operating environment such as a Liquified Natural Gas (LNG) Facility, Refinery or Chemicals facility.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B. Tech) in relevant engineering discipline (mechanical, process, etc..) from a recognized (AICTE) university or trade/craft background
* High level of skill using Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Visio and SharePoint, as well as Adobe Professional


**What We Can Offer You**
 Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.
   

  

 Have the opportunity to take part in world\-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.
   

  

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.

* Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.


**diversity, equity \& inclusion statement**
 Chevron values inclusivity and promotes a workplace that seeks to welcome contributions from all people. We encourage people of all abilities, genders, cultures, and backgrounds to apply.
   

  

 Chevron is committed to building a safe and respectful workplace where everyone is valued for their contribution to our energy future.
   

  

 Chevron participates in E\-Verify in certain locations as required by law.

 **APPLY** 
 to submit your application.
